title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Technical Program Manager – AI-Enabled Engineering Pods
  
  
Role Title: Technical Program Manager – Full Stack, Cloud & AI Engineering
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Experience Required: Minimum 14+ years of experience
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned
**Technical Program Manager**
to lead and manage multiple cross-functional engineering pod teams based in Hyderabad. This role requires strong technical depth, hands-on understanding of modern full stack engineering practices, cloud-native platforms, DevSecOps, and practical experience using AI and Gen AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, delivery predictability, quality, and operational excellence.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have prior experience managing complex technology programs involving distributed engineering teams, product owners, architects, developers, QA engineers, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders. The candidate must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels — driving roadmap alignment, technical delivery, architecture discussions, release governance, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive-level reporting.
  
  
This is not a pure project management role. The candidate is expected to bring strong technical judgment, understand engineering trade-offs, challenge solution approaches where required, and guide teams toward scalable, secure, maintainable, and AI-enabled delivery practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead multiple engineering pod teams delivering full stack, cloud-native, and enterprise-grade digital applications.
* Own end-to-end program execution across planning, design, development, testing, release, deployment, and production support.
* Drive delivery predictability across multiple pods by managing scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, milestones, and release commitments.
* Partner with product owners, architects, engineering managers, QA leads, DevOps teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms across sprint planning, backlog refinement, architecture reviews, dependency tracking, release planning, and production readiness.
* Monitor execution health across pods and proactively address blockers, capacity gaps, technical risks, and cross-team dependencies.
* Drive alignment between business objectives, product priorities, technical architecture, and delivery execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered with strong focus on quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational stability.

**Technical Program Management**

* Facilitate technical design discussions across .NET Core, Angular, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, DevSecOps, and integration platforms.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to validate solution approaches, identify architectural risks, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards.
* Drive technical governance across application architecture, API design, cloud integration, security, performance, observability, and deployment practices.
* Ensure engineering teams follow clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding practices, CI/CD standards, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Track and manage technical debt, platform modernization initiatives, production stability issues, and engineering improvement plans.
* Support teams in resolving production issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, cloud services, and deployment pipelines.
* Ensure delivery teams adopt appropriate engineering metrics, including sprint predictability, defect leakage, deployment frequency, change failure rate, code quality, test coverage, and production incident trends.

**AI & Gen AI Enablement**

* Drive responsible adoption of AI and Gen AI tools across engineering pods to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, testing, and problem-solving.
* Enable teams to use platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or similar enterprise-approved AI platforms.
* Identify practical AI use cases across software delivery, including code generation, refactoring, unit test generation, API documentation, technical design documentation, defect analysis, and security review support.
* Establish AI usage guardrails aligned with enterprise security, data privacy, compliance, intellectual property, and responsible AI policies.
* Partner with engineering and security teams to evaluate AI-assisted development workflows and ensure safe adoption.
* Track productivity and quality improvements resulting from AI-enabled engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of AI-assisted engineering while ensuring human accountability for design, code quality, security, and production outcomes.

**Agile, DevSecOps & Release Governance**

* Lead agile execution across multiple pods using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* Drive consistent sprint ceremonies, backlog hygiene, estimation practices, release planning, and execution governance.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, quality gates, code reviews, test automation, security scans, and release approvals are integrated into delivery workflows.
* Partner with DevOps and platform teams to improve deployment reliability, environment stability, monitoring, logging, and incident response.
* Ensure production releases meet defined entry and exit criteria, including quality, security, performance, and operational readiness checks.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, agile maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and delivery effectiveness.

**Stakeholder & Executive Communication**

* Provide clear, concise, and data-driven program updates to senior leadership, including Directors, VPs, and CXO-level stakeholders where required.
* Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, financial impacts, delivery trade-offs, and mitigation plans with appropriate executive clarity.
* Prepare roadmap views, release dashboards, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and program health reports.
* Translate complex technical topics into business-relevant insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Drive decision-making across competing priorities, delivery constraints, architecture options, and risk scenarios.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 14+ years of overall technology experience, with strong background in software engineering, technical delivery, program management, or engineering leadership.
* Proven experience managing multiple engineering pods or cross-functional agile teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong technical understanding of full stack application delivery using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, Angular, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, backend services, cloud-native application patterns, and scalable web architectures.
* Experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, identity management, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, Git-based workflows, automated deployment, and production release governance.
* Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Practical experience using AI or Gen AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Q, Gemini, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery models, sprint execution, roadmap planning, dependency management, and engineering metrics.
* Ability to challenge technical assumptions, identify delivery risks, and drive resolution across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, security, and business teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to engage senior leadership and technical teams with equal effectiveness.

**Preferred Technical Capabilities**

* Prior hands-on software engineering experience before moving into technical program management or engineering leadership.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, or digital product engineering programs.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, insurance, life sciences, or other compliance-heavy environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture governance, security reviews, audit requirements, and compliance controls.
* Experience with observability platforms, production support models, SRE practices, and incident management.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted SDLC practices across large engineering teams.
* Understanding of responsible AI, AI governance, data privacy, secure prompt usage, and enterprise AI adoption frameworks.

**AI Platform Expectations**
The candidate should be hands-on and comfortable using AI platforms to:
  
  

* Improve engineering productivity across multiple pod teams.
* Assist with code review, code generation, and refactoring analysis.
* Generate unit test cases and improve test coverage.
* Support API documentation, architecture documentation, and technical design documentation.
* Analyze technical designs, logs, defects, and production issues for faster triage.
* Identify security, performance, and maintainability concerns in application delivery.
* Build reusable AI-enabled workflows for engineering teams.
* Promote responsible AI adoption in alignment with enterprise policies.
* Ensure AI tools are used as productivity accelerators while preserving engineering accountability, security, and compliance.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate independently in a senior leadership-facing role.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to lead multiple teams through ambiguity, changing priorities, and complex dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance delivery speed with technical quality, security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills with ability to simplify complex technical issues for executive audiences.
* Ability to mentor pod leads, scrum masters, technical leads, and engineering teams on delivery discipline and engineering best practices.
* Strong execution discipline with focus on measurable outcomes, delivery transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Lead, Tech (QTE)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a Lead, Tech to join the Quality and Test Engineering group based in the firm’s office in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The Quality and Test Engineering (QTE) team manages the entire firm’s quality mandate and delivers quality product releases with deep integration in the software development cycle, focusing on functional correctness, scalability, and performance. Our prime motivation is to mature the software development cycle by bringing robust test-engineering practices, automation, tooling, and quality product releases.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this position, you will be responsible for developing automation tools/frameworks, understanding the domain, testing and automating complex projects, managing and mentoring a small group of test engineers, and driving innovation by improving on or introducing new tools/processes to improve efficiency and quality. Additionally, you will also collaborate closely with our business domain from a testing perspective. This includes involvement with various asset classes that the firm trades in, working with our state-of-the-art trading systems, exchange connectivity, pricing/forecasting models, and ensuring that our business-critical processes and workflows function exactly as intended. To elaborate further, you will focus on productivity through automation and tooling, developing end-to-end functional and integration test-case scenarios with an exceptional emphasis on the business domain, owning end-to-end QTE processes, and release planning. Furthermore, you will also have to exhibit leadership in test-case development, coordinate test-plan reviews, and generate repeatable test procedures.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
**Basic qualifications:**

* 6 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* The ability to rapidly learn complex domains and model workflows; translate requirements into test strategy
* Experience in building and improving test processes with an increased focus on business context
* Experience validating distributed/microservices systems and event driven workflows
* Experience working with a high-level, object-oriented programming language like Java/C++
* Exposure to scripting languages like Bash/Python
* Knowledge of unit testing frameworks like jUnit, TestNG, and API test automation
* Exposure to UI stacks like React/Redux
* Working experience in UNIX or one of its flavors
* Familiarity with performance/reliability testing and basic observability

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Linkedin/LeasTechSDEMay24
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Release Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Release Manager to manage end-to-end software release planning, coordination, scheduling, deployment, and governance. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Release Management, Change Management, ITIL processes, and coordination across Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Business teams to ensure smooth and reliable production releases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the end-to-end release lifecycle, from planning and scheduling to deployment and post-release validation.
* Develop and maintain release calendars, deployment plans, release notes, checklists, and implementation documentation.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Business teams to ensure release readiness.
* Manage change requests, conduct impact and risk assessments, and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
* Coordinate Go/No-Go meetings and obtain the necessary approvals before production deployments.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes, release governance, organizational policies, and compliance requirements.
* Track release dependencies, risks, issues, milestones, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate production deployments, rollback plans, hotfixes, emergency releases, and post-release validation.
* Monitor release KPIs, including deployment success rate, change failure rate, rollback frequency, and on-time delivery.
* Manage release communications and provide timely updates to stakeholders and senior management.
* Conduct post-release reviews and drive continuous improvement in release processes.
* Support incident reviews and root cause analysis related to release failures or production issues.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in IT, with significant hands-on experience in Release Management.
* Strong knowledge of end-to-end release planning, deployment coordination, and release governance.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes, particularly Release, Change, Incident, and Problem Management.
* Experience managing CAB meetings, change approvals, release readiness, and Go/No-Go decisions.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and risk management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple releases, competing priorities, and tight deployment timelines.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams in enterprise IT environments.

title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET)
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**The job**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and modern quality engineering solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in C#, hands-on experience with MSTest/FlaUI, expertise in Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and practical experience leveraging GitHub Copilot to accelerate test automation development, improve code quality, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* 6–10 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or quality engineering, with substantial hands-on development experience.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks using C# and FlaUI for Desktop Based application which is also enabled in Browser based.
* Integrate automated tests with Microsoft Test Platform and compatible test runners.
* Troubleshoot test failures, debug application behavior, and resolve automation framework issues.
* Use GitHub Copilot to accelerate the development of test scripts, reusable automation utilities, and test framework components.
* Leverage AI-assisted coding to generate test scenarios, test data variations, assertions, and negative test cases.
* Use GitHub Copilot to assist with code refactoring, debugging, documentation, and unit test development.
* Design, implement, and maintain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for automated test execution.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD workflows to enable continuous validation. Experience with Git

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Test Platform, VSTest, and automated test execution tools.
* Knowledge of REST API automation using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or other UI automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of SQL and database validation.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation setup, execution, and reporting.
* Experience with Azure DevOps REST APIs, pipeline artifacts, and test reporting.
* Familiarity with parallel execution, distributed test environments, and regression optimization.
* Understanding of AI-assisted software development, prompt engineering, and AI-generated code validation.
* Experience measuring engineering productivity and automation effectiveness. .

**Measurable Performance Outcomes**
Performance will be assessed against agreed project baselines and delivery objectives.
  
  

* Automation coverage: Increase automated coverage of prioritized regression scenarios.
* Execution efficiency: Reduce regression execution time through optimization and parallelization where feasible.
* Test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, false failures, and recurring automation issues.
* CI/CD integration: Ensure agreed test suites execute reliably through Azure DevOps pipelines with published results.
* AI-assisted productivity: Demonstrate measurable improvements in test development or maintenance efficiency using GitHub Copilot.
* Code quality: Maintain reusable, reviewable, secure, and maintainable automation code.
* Defect detection: Improve early identification of critical defects and regressions.
* Knowledge sharing: Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant software testing, automation, or Microsoft technology certifications are desirable but not mandatory.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on Senior SDET with strong C# and MSTest expertise, proven Azure DevOps CI/CD experience, and the ability to apply GitHub Copilot effectively in test automation engineering. They can independently develop automation solutions, improve framework reliability, optimize test execution, and mentor other engineers while maintaining high standards of software quality.
  
  
**R&D at AVEVA**
Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
  
  
Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. title: Application Engineering Technical Lead - II
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

The role needs strong technical credibility combined with people management and engineering operations discipline.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own delivery governance across multiple pods: sprint commitments, release plans, milestones and quality outcomes.
* Manage staffing, onboarding, knowledge transfer, continuity planning and timely replacements so teams stay fully productive.
* Track and manage risks, dependencies and issues across pods, and drive escalations to closure with client and internal stakeholders.
* Define, track and report engineering metrics (velocity, predictability, defect leakage, cycle time, test coverage) and drive improvement actions.
* Prepare regular status reports and steering-committee updates for client and Kanerika leadership.
* Support timesheet management, effort tracking and invoicing reconciliation.
* Partner with Tech Leads and the AI Architect on technical direction, capacity planning and engineering best practices.
* Coach and mentor Tech Leads and engineers, and drive performance management, career growth and team engagement.
* Ensure adherence to SDLC, security, compliance, CI/CD and definition-of-done standards across pods.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years as an Engineering Manager or Delivery Manager.
* Proven experience managing multiple agile teams (20+ engineers) on enterprise software or SaaS engagements.
* Technical background in Java, Python or full-stack development, enough to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery at scale, including multi-team planning, dependency management and release governance.
* Experience with staffing, resource planning, onboarding and people management.
* Hands-on experience defining and reporting engineering KPIs and delivery metrics.
* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot, Python, Angular, microservices and AWS/Azure cloud.
* Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, test automation and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence and delivery reporting tools such as Excel or Power BI.
* Familiarity with Time & Material engagements, timesheets and invoicing processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and escalation-handling skills.

* Experience delivering AI/ML, GenAI or data platform programs.
* Domain exposure to data privacy, governance, security or compliance products.

title: Staff Test Lead

**Job Description**

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
****The Team****
Engineering - Our engineering team is at the core of our products and connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks. We are constantly innovating — challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don’t shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, excited by the prospect of a challenge, and empowered by the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are only enabled by a secure digital environment.
  
  
******Job Summary******
Hire, build, and rapidly scale the engineering team to meet the hyper-growth plans for the India office, in accordance with the company’s business goals.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Practice all software development life cycle in an agile oriented environment with emphasis on code quality, supportability, scalability and performance.
* Design and implement the product from scratch to production.
* Research and implement sophisticated Cyber security mechanisms.
* Explore new technologies and tools to keep us using cutting edge solutions.
* Nurture a culture of innovation and drive local initiatives that enable continuous growth of individuals and the organization.
* Engage with various stakeholders and the Product Management Team to establish a product roadmap and release schedule.
* Foster leadership principles and behaviors throughout the organization to groom the next generation of engineering leaders.
* Partner with HR and executives for key India site-wide initiatives and facilitate the local operations.
* Drive AI-first engineering Practices through the adoption of emerging technologies, trends, and continuous innovation.

****Qualifications****
****Required Qualifications****

* BS or equivalent with a major degree in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering.
* 12+ years of hands-on experience in building enterprise software.
* 5+ years in hiring, leading, and scaling high-performance and results-oriented engineering teams.
* Deep understanding of backend systems and distributed architectures, with the ability to lead technical strategy and architectural decisions for scalable, high-performance platforms.
* AI-forward engineering mindset, with a track of leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve developer productivity, software quality, and innovation.
* Hands-on technical experience with building enterprise-scale SaaS products, preferably around Identity and Access Management.
* Very strong software engineering – design, development experience.
* Proven track record to grow and manage an engineering team of 10+ with an ability to provide leadership vision for further expansion.
* Deep understanding of Agile development practices and other engineering processes.
* Hands-on technical knowledge of Software Security, Multi-tenancy, Scalability, and High Availability.

******Preferred Qualifications******

* Working experience with designing a scalable Web Solution. Experience with Microservice architecture, AWS technology stack and serverless is preferable.
* Proficient in Python/Go/Node/Ruby/Java (spring boot, spring batch)/C# (.Net Core)/C++. Experience with modern CI/CD tools is preferable.
* Proficient and seasoned in handling SCRUM teams involving Devs and QA.
* Prior experience with driving continuous improvement and the ability to implement creative ideas to significantly improve the overall performance of the team.
* Experience working at a high growth, fast-paced technology company.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Sr Manager, Scrum Master Senior
description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As a highly influential individual contributor you will take ownership of software delivery using Agile and Scaled Agile methodologies for multiple Scrum and/or Kanban teams. As a Servant-leader you will mentor, train and lead process improvements on Agile and Scaled Agile practices and ceremonies to ensure that business and engineering value is being created through predictable, continuous, high-quality releases. You will also manage several development teams through all phases of theAgile Delivery lifecycle and create summary and detailed reports that capture trends and snapshots in a clear and concise manner.
  
  
You will play a key role in the following areas:
  
  

* Interact, communicate, and manage team and platform-level expectations with Technology and Business leaders.
* Collaborate with Product leaders on vision and roadmap to understand, plan and facilitate Agile/Scaled Agile release planning sessions.
* Assist Engineering leadership to create innovative information radiators and progress reports for Technology, Business and Operations partners.
* Coach and mentor Product Owners and Scrum and Kanban teams within the ASDD organization so that they become empowered and self-organized users of Agile SDLC.
* Partner with Scrum Masters across AWAT developing and maintaining standards, tools, and best practices in the Agile framework.
* Partner with the ASDD Release Train Engineer (RTE) to apply Scaled Agile best practices consistently across the release train.
* Work with other Scrum Masters in the overall Technology organization to increase the effectiveness of Agile application.
* Lead multiple Agile teams within ASDD to make measurable, continuous improvement in their use of Agile ceremonies and practices.
* Facilitate and ensure optimized adherence and implementation of all Agile ceremonies and practices on a day-to-day basis.

**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent work experience.
  
  

* 7+ years of current experience as a Scrum Master working with cross-functional leaders and team members.
* 10+ years of experience in the technology industry working on complex, enterprise level products.
* Hands-On experience with implementing Agile (Scrum and Kanban) and Scaled Agile.
* Current “Certified Scrum Master” (CSM) certification is required.
* Experience with a Scaled Agile framework, with an understanding of PI planning across multiple dependent teams required.
* Hands on expertise using Agile Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools in the Atlassian family i.e. JIRA, Confluence etc. is required.
* Ability to apply scrum estimation and planning techniques, including managing and tracking external dependencies.
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority.
* Previous hands-on experience in a financial services setting i.e. broker/dealer services, investor services, wealth management is a significant plus.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with diverse personality types.
* Ability to understand and explain technical issues at a high level.
* Exceptional communication, organization, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead, mentor and coach cross-functional teams to reach their highest potential.
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolutions skills, collaborative approach to driving results.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  
  
▪ Hands on experience using Rally, SharePoint and Clarity.
  
  
▪ Synthesizes complex data, manages resources, and develops strategic insights
  
  
▪ Collaborates across teams, facilitates partnerships, and supports cooperative efforts
  
  
▪ Provides thought leadership in the business area and independently drives strategic initiatives
  
  
▪ Supports peers in technical areas to refine their knowledge, skills, and abilities
  
  
▪ Manages complex interactions to maintain productive professional relationships
  
  
▪ Creates processes to help others successfully manage organization-wide change
  
  
▪ Verbally articulates ideas impactfully, fostering open dialogue
  
  
▪ Inspires confidence with proven expertise, integrity, and accurate communication
  
  
▪ Sets performance-driven goals across groups and drives continuous improvement
  
  
▪ Leverages diverse expertise to develop strategies in cross-functional projects or programs
  
  
▪ Creates clear, persuasive, and professional written documents that meet business standards

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member II - Guidewire PolicyCenter

This position works with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, and Agile team members to develop, test, and deploy Guidewire PolicyCenter configuration and integration solutions. The role uses foundational to intermediate Guidewire development skills, follows established coding and design standards, and delivers reliable working functionality each sprint with support and guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Interprets customer and business needs and provides technical input into feasible application solutions and system design
* Codes and configures programs, objects, components, and packaged software using established standards and conventions
* Documents implementation details and performs quality checks on code, configuration, related components, test evidence, and supporting documentation
* Delivers working functionality incrementally each sprint and modifies existing code or configuration to meet approved requirements
* Performs detailed impact assessments across people, processes, data, applications, and integrations; identifies and raises functional design risks
* Partners with the Product Owner and team to confirm that implementation and acceptance tests reflect the intended functionality
* Applies Test-Driven Development and Behavior-Driven Development practices where appropriate to build quality into the solution
* Uses data creation tools, reviews automated test results, and applies basic development and test automation frameworks
* Supports application implementation, release, environment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions with guidance
* Takes ownership of assigned deliverables, communicates status and impediments, and completes issue resolution in a timely manner

**Guidewire Technical Requirements**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in software development, solution engineering, or a related technology field
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with Guidewire products, preferably PolicyCenter, including configuration and integration development
* Hands-on exposure to Guidewire products, preferably PolicyCenter, through configuration, integration, support, testing, or implementation work
* Foundational experience with PolicyCenter configuration, including product model, business rules, workflows, user interface components, data model extensions, and validation logic
* Ability to read, write, and modify Gosu code, page configuration files, business rules, data model extensions, and basic unit tests such as GUnit tests
* Basic understanding of PolicyCenter integrations using REST services, Guidewire APIs, messaging, events, plugins, batch processes, and enterprise system interfaces
* Working knowledge of source control, build processes, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and environment support practices
* Guidewire Cloud or SaaS delivery exposure is preferred. Advanced Product Designer or Jutro Digital Platform exposure is a plus
* Foundational property and casualty insurance knowledge, including products, coverages, underwriting processes, and integration touchpoints

**Agile Delivery and Collaboration**

* Writes and refines user stories with clear technical tasks and accurate acceptance criteria; estimates work using relative sizing
* Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities
* Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and owns assigned work items
* Demonstrates working functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos
* Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps
* Actively develops T-shaped skills, participates in Communities of Practice, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement
* Works effectively across development, testing, product, architecture, and business partners to improve flow and transparency

**Requirements**
**Additional Qualifications**

* Strong verbal communication, listening, writing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to adjust technical detail for the audience
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including breaking down moderately complex issues, identifying root cause, comparing alternatives, and recommending a viable solution
* Ability to use data to identify meaningful information, patterns, or conclusions and to organize the steps needed to address an issue

title: Sr Quality Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins.
* Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices.
* Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers.
* Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production.
* Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems — including reconciliation checks — to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions.
* Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions.
* Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit.
* Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability.
* Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team — identifying dependencies and escalating risks early.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes.
* Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery.
* Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages.
* Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows — including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools — with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated.
* Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based test planning, and the appropriate balance of unit, component, integration, and end-to-end coverage, combined with experience with API automation for REST and/or gRPC services and web automation frameworks such as Playwright (preferred), Selenium, or WebdriverIO.
* Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for test data preparation and validation, with the ability to investigate data consistency issues across integrated systems and diagnose failures using logs and API responses.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, working with Git-based code review (GitHub/GitLab), and testing in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, alongside familiarity with test case management and API testing tools such as TestRail and Postman.

efficiency.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**About Consilio**
**Consilio**
is a global leader in legal consulting and technology services, empowering multinational law firms and corporations with innovative legal solutions. We help clients manage complex legal, regulatory, and data challenges through expertise, technology, and scale.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support our Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams. This role is responsible for ensuring Agile teams operate efficiently, predictably, and in alignment with organizational delivery standards while facilitating the successful execution of initiatives across multiple technology teams and stakeholder groups.
  
  
The Scrum Master will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, promote Agile best practices, enforce workflow discipline, and drive continuous improvement across one or more technical delivery teams. In addition, this role will play a critical part in managing cross-team dependencies, coordinating work across interconnected teams, and proactively addressing risks and blockers that may impact delivery commitments.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a servant leader who excels at dependency management, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder engagement. Success in this role requires the ability to facilitate alignment among Product Owners, Developers, QA resources, Project Managers, business stakeholders, and leadership while ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions in a complex data and analytics environment.
  
  
This position requires a Scrum Master who combines strong Agile expertise with sufficient technical knowledge of Data Warehouse, reporting, integration, and data platform concepts to effectively support delivery teams and facilitate technical discussions. The Scrum Master serves as a trusted partner to engineering teams and stakeholders, driving transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement while ensuring delivery objectives are achieved.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Agile Leadership & Team Facilitation**

* Serve as Scrum Master for Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams, promoting Agile best practices and team effectiveness.
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-Ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Release Planning.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain prioritized backlogs, ensure work is appropriately defined and estimated, and support predictable delivery.
* Administer and maintain Jira boards, workflows, dashboards, and reporting to support effective planning, execution, and transparency.
* Monitor Agile metrics, sprint commitments, release objectives, capacity, delivery forecasts, and overall delivery health; communicate progress, risks, and key insights to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement through team coaching, impediment removal, retrospective action planning, process optimization, and release readiness activities.

**Cross-Team Dependency Management**

* Identify, track, and manage dependencies across Data Warehouse, Domo, Business Intelligence, integration, and application development teams.
* Coordinate dependent workstreams to ensure alignment of priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
* Facilitate resolution of cross-team blockers, resource constraints, and competing priorities impacting delivery.
* Partner with technical leads and stakeholders to develop mitigation plans for dependency-related risks.
* Escalate unresolved issues and critical dependencies to leadership when necessary to maintain delivery commitments.

title: TD and E-TD-Scrum Lead Specialist-Senior
description:

EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
The Technical Scrum Lead, Specialist is responsible for driving Agile adoption and execution within technology teams, ensuring efficient sprint execution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role involves facilitating Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, to keep teams aligned and productive.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead cross-functional agile teams in iterative technology development, ensuring smooth collaboration and adherence to Agile/Scrum principles.
* Coach teams on best practices, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improving agile maturity.
* Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to define, prioritize and align technology-related outcomes with business goals.
* Identify and proactively remove roadblocks that hinder project progress, ensuring teams have the necessary resources and support.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by maintaining transparency around scope, schedule and budget while effectively addressing concerns.
* Facilitate key agile ceremonies such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
* Assist teams in estimating deliverables, increasing velocity and identifying opportunities for efficiency.
* Maintain product and sprint backlogs, ensuring tasks are documented, prioritized and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Apply agile methodologies to integrate changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology-related product development.
* Serve as a mentor, thought leader and agile champion, participating in special projects to drive organizational agility.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in Agile project management, Scrum Master roles, or technical leadership in software development.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban and SAFe frameworks, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and other Agile project management tools.
* Proficiency in coding and technical concepts, including Java, Angular, Node.js, POSTMAN, CUCUMBER, AWS and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, TDD/BDD and monitoring tools like Splunk and Honeycomb.
* Experience in monitoring and refining dashboards, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous process improvements in Agile environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and Professional Scrum Master (CSM, PSM, SAFe) certification is preferred.
* Experience with Genesis
* Programming experience in Python, TypeScript.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon.
  
  
We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will:
  
  
Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off.
  
  
Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase.
  
  
Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response.
  
  
Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on.
  
  
Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does.
  
  
You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience scripting or coding
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment
* Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
* Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Delivery lead cum Scrum Master to join our dynamic team and drive our agile practices within the Data & Analytics team. As a Senior Scrum Master, you will play a crucial role in helping the team to deliver high-impact projects that enhance our retail and e-commerce. You will be responsible for guiding multiple scrum teams, ensuring effective agile practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You will work closely with product owners, development teams, technology & leadership to ensure that our Data & Analytics solutions meet business needs and drive operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Scrum Operations: Setting up the Scrum structure including the JIRA boards, labelling, swim lanes, effort estimates, prioritization, performance, documentation management, testing, deployment etc.
* Facilitate Scrum Events: Lead daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring teams are aligned and focused on delivering high-quality products.
* Guide Agile Practices: Mentor and coach scrum teams on agile methodologies, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous improvement.
* Remove Impediments: Identify and resolve obstacles that may hinder the team’s progress, escalating issues when necessary to maintain momentum.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and other teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and ensure clear communication of project status and timelines.
* Performance Tracking: Monitor team performance using agile metrics and KPIs, such as velocity, burndown charts, and cycle time, to provide insights and drive improvement.
* Improvements: Continuously assess and enhance agile processes and practices within the teams, leveraging feedback and lessons learned to optimize delivery based on the retrospective team’s throughput & operational performance
* Risk Management: Proactively identify potential risks and dependencies, working with the team and stakeholders to mitigate them and ensure successful project delivery.
* Process Management: Define, own and drive the processes for new project intake, incident / breakdowns, small scale upgrades etc. and translating them into scrum operations
* Communications: Lead the engagement, alignment & integration with the larger portfolio & project management office along with enterprise communications about Data & Analytics project statuses, business impact, challenges, risks, dependencies etc. for visibility & transparency
* Miscellaneous: Conducting & coordinating online fun events and celebrating small/big successes/team's accomplishments for enabling greater collaboration among the team members across the globe,
* Sending Newsletters for recognition, celebrating small/big successes/team's accomplishments etc.
* (Optional) Coordinate & conduct online fun events for enabling greater collaborations among the team members across the globe

**Qualifications:**

* Experience: Minimum of 7-10 years of experience as a Scrum Master & Delivery Manager, with at least 2 years in a senior role, preferably within the Data & Analytics function in retail, or e-commerce domain.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. A master’s degree is a plus.
* Certifications: Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM). Advanced certifications such as SAFe Scrum Master or Certified Agile Coach are highly desirable.
* Agile Expertise: Deep understanding of agile principles, frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, etc.), and best practices, with a proven track record of successful agile implementations.
* Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing solutions.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead and inspire teams, driving a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* (Strong plus though not mandatory) Functional understanding: Deep Understanding of Data & Analytics functions particularly within the retail or e-commerce industry.

title: Specialist Scrum Master - AI Products & Platforms
description:
**Specialist Scrum Master – AI Products & Platforms**
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
  
  
The Specialist Scrum Master will provide senior Agile delivery leadership and coaching for AI products and platforms within Amgen’s AI & Data Organization. The role partners with product, engineering, data science and business stakeholders to improve delivery outcomes, team effectiveness and cross-team alignment.

* Lead and continuously improve Agile delivery for one or more AI product or platform teams, adapting Scrum and Kanban practices to team context and delivery needs.
