* Partner with product and technical leaders to translate roadmaps and business priorities into clear goals, sequenced backlogs and achievable delivery plans.
* Facilitate planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives, refinement and demonstrations. Ensure ceremonies result in clear decisions, ownership and follow-through.
* Identify and manage delivery risks, impediments, dependencies and capacity constraints. Drive timely resolution and escalate issues with clear impact, options and recommendations.
* Coordinate across teams and functions to align milestones, integration points and shared dependencies; represent team needs in cross-team planning and governance forums as appropriate.
* Use Jira, Confluence and delivery data to provide transparent reporting on progress, commitments, outcomes, risks and trends. Help leaders understand delivery health without relying on activity-only measures.
* Analyze predictability, flow, cycle time, scope changes and other relevant indicators to identify improvement opportunities. Facilitate experiments and track whether changes improve outcomes.
* Build team ownership, psychological safety and continuous improvement. Support conflict resolution and help teams address challenges constructively.
* Promote practical engineering and quality practices, including appropriate testing, automation, DevOps collaboration and responsible use of AI-enabled delivery tools.
* Contribute to Agile practice consistency and knowledge sharing across the AI & Data Organization; mentor Scrum Masters and support broader capability building as needed.
* Ensure Agile ways of working accommodate the needs of global, distributed and cross-functional teams.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, business or a related field and 8 to 12 years of relevant experience, including substantial experience as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery lead; OR An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Relevant experience should include leading Agile teams, coaching product and engineering partners, and improving delivery outcomes in technology or digital product environments.
  
  
**Functional Skills:**
**Must-Have Skills:**

* Recognized Scrum Master or Agile certification (e.g., CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience facilitating Agile delivery and coaching teams and stakeholders beyond basic ceremony facilitation.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum and Kanban practices, backlog refinement, story slicing, estimation, sprint or flow planning, and continuous improvement.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence for team delivery, planning, risk visibility and reporting; Jira Align experience is beneficial where applicable.
* Ability to manage cross-team dependencies, delivery risks, impediments and competing priorities in a complex, changing environment.
* Experience using delivery metrics thoughtfully to identify trends, improve predictability and support informed decisions.
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle and collaboration across product, engineering, data science, quality and operations.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Experience supporting AI, data science, cloud, platform or other technically complex product teams.
* Working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, test automation, technical debt and software quality practices.
* SAFe or other scaling framework experience, with the ability to apply only the practices that add value to the teams.
* Experience mentoring Scrum Masters or contributing to an Agile community of practice.

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent facilitation, coaching, influencing and conflict-resolution skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical delivery topics into concise business language.
* Sound judgment and analytical problem-solving skills; able to distinguish meaningful delivery signals from activity metrics.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with global, virtual and cross-functional teams at different organizational levels.
* High degree of initiative, adaptability and accountability; able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on outcomes.
* Collaborative and inclusive approach that encourages team ownership, learning and continuous improvement.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

title: QA Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth**

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom.

**Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia**
. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning).

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (~₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.

**This is not an 'offshore' support role.**
Our India team is a
**core product hub**
, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.

**The Role: Engineering Confidence**

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."

Here’s what you can look forward to in this role.

* **Engineer the Safety Net**
  : You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
* **Shift Quality Left**
  : You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
* **Pragmatic Quality**
  : While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
* **Drive CI/CD Velocity**
  : You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
* **Guardian of the Client Experience**
  : You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Web Automation**
  : We use
  **Playwright**
  for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications.
* **Backend Automation**
  : We use
  **Cucumber-Scala**
  to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure.
* **Mobile Automation**
  : We leverage
  **Maestro E2E**
  and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps.
* **Ops**
  : We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on
  **CI/CD**
  to run your tests on every commit.

**Want to look under the hood?**
Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at
tech.endowus.com

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 Days (Immersion)**
  : You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release.
* **First 90 Days (Ownership)**
  : You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage.
* **First 6 Months (Impact)**
  : You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a “founder mentality”.

**What You Bring (Requirements)**

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline:

**Must-Haves**
:

* **4+ Years of Test Engineering**
  : You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation.
* **Strong Coding Fundamentals**
  : You are proficient in at least one major language (
  **Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python**
  ). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding.
* **Automation Framework Competence**
  : You have experience using and extending frameworks like
  **Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium**
  . You can write stable, maintainable scripts.
* **API Testing DNA**
  : You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states.
* **Collaborative Mindset**
  : You don't wait for a "hand-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better

**Nice-to-Haves**
:

* **Mobile Automation**
  : Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro.
* **Performance Testing**
  : Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter.
* **FinTech Domain**
  : You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

**Why Endowus?**

* **Modern Stack, Serious Business**
  : You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World-Class Engineering Talent**
  : You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside**
  : We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree**
  : Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.

**Why NOT Endowus?**

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.

* **You prefer 100% Automation**
  : If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you.
* **You prefer a Centralized QA Structure**
  : If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging.
* **You prefer executing over planning**
  : If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves.
* **You want 100% Remote**
  : We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

**The Interview Process**

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.

* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
* Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios.
* System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management.
* Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

The successful candidate will work closely with business application teams and key engineering stakeholders to drive adoption of observability services, influence product direction through customer feedback, lead delivery execution through an agile squad, and scale observability capabilities that enhance service reliability, accelerate operational excellence, and support DTCC's evolution toward AI-enabled operations. Through this leadership opportunity, the candidate will play a critical role in shaping how developers, Site Reliability Engineers, Application Support Engineers, Client Operations teams, and technology leaders leverage observability to improve service reliability, accelerate problem resolution, and enhance the stability of DTCC's mission-critical financial services ecosystem.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Customer Engagement, Adoption and Value Realization- Own the customer relationship lifecycle from intake and discovery through delivery, adoption, and outcome review.
  
  

* Guide application teams to the appropriate service-catalog offerings and drive successful consumption of approved observability services.
* Translate observability capabilities into measurable operational, reliability, productivity, and customer outcomes; track adoption, utilization, value, and onboarding friction.
* Represent EAS Observability with business-unit and application stakeholders, ensuring engagements align with established observability priorities, standards, and strategic objectives.

Product Ownership and Delivery- Translate customer needs and strategic priorities into product requirements, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
  
  

* Own and prioritize the squad backlog using business value, enterprise priorities, risk, dependencies, capacity, and technical input.
* Lead Agile delivery activities with the Scrum Master and technical leads; coordinate cross-functional execution and actively manage risks, decisions, impediments, and dependencies.
* Provide concise, decision-oriented reporting on roadmap execution, adoption, delivery health, risks, and outcomes.

Service Catalog and Self-Service- Operate and continuously improve the observability service catalog as the primary customer engagement and service-consumption mechanism.
  
  

* Standardize intake, onboarding, documentation, enablement, and support to move suitable services toward repeatable self-service consumption.
* Convert recurring needs and onboarding friction into backlog improvements, reusable patterns, automation, documentation, and enablement materials.
* Lead organizational rollout and adoption of approved new services, products, and features.

Capability Design and Governance Alignment- Contribute customer, product, delivery, and adoption perspectives to service and feature design.
  
  

* Translate business needs into product requirements, and work with the observability squad to introduce new capabilities, features, and service improvements that increase customer value and adoption.
* Remain informed of new products and features, assess customer and catalog impacts, and coordinate rollout after direction and design decisions are established.
* Align delivery with approved observability standards, technology controls, operational-readiness expectations, and applicable risk, compliance, and audit requirements.

People and Squad Leadership- Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, including a Scrum Master and assigned developers.
  
  

* Mature Scrum Master capability across facilitation, delivery discipline, transparency, impediment management, metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Set clear goals and accountability, provide feedback and development support, delegate effectively, and foster an inclusive, outcome-oriented engineering culture.

Qualifications- 10+ years of related experience in technology product ownership, product management, delivery, engineering, platform operations, business analysis, or a comparable field.
  
  

* Proven ownership of technology products or services from stakeholder discovery and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and outcome measurement.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and influence skills in complex, cross-functional, and cross-regional organizations.
* Significant delivery experience in financial services, fintech, capital markets, banking, or another highly regulated, mission-critical environment.
* Experience leading direct reports and cross-functional Agile teams, including coaching Scrum or delivery-management capability.
* Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into customer journeys, prioritized work, adoption plans, and measurable business outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience- Observability, monitoring, reliability engineering, SRE, platform engineering, production support, or operational resilience.
  
  

* Metrics, logs, traces, alerting, APM, synthetic monitoring, SLI/SLO practices, and operational dashboards; exposure to Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, Open Telemetry, or comparable technologies.
* Technology service catalogs, standardized onboarding, automation, self-service, platform migration, cloud transformation, or modernization programs.
* CSPO, PSPO, or comparable products or Agile certification.

Talents Needed for Success- Business-value orientation and strong customer leadership.
  
  

* Product judgment, execution discipline, and clear priority management.
* People leadership, coaching, delegation, and accountability.
* Technical curiosity and effective partnership without displacing technical authority.
* Enterprise mindset, risk awareness, and concise executive communication.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
← Back to careers
  
  
Founder's Office
  
  
Founder's Office Intern
  
  
Location Anywhere in India (IST / similar timezone)
  
  
Experience Final-year student or recent graduate; prior internship or project ownership preferred
  
  
Employment Internship (3–6 months)
  
  
Compensation Competitive stipend
  
  
Reporting to Founders
  
  
**About The Role**
Qonfido is building an AI companion for money, helping people organise, understand, and grow their wealth with clarity and confidence.
  
  
As a Founder's Office Intern, you will sit at the centre of the company: close to strategy, product, data, and day-to-day execution. This is not a shadowing internship. You will own real workstreams, present recommendations to founders, and help turn ambiguity into decisions and decisions into shipped outcomes.
  
  
You will move across strategy setting, data analysis, product management support, AI optimisation, and operational follow-through, learning how a modern fintech startup actually runs.
  
  
If you are curious, structured, comfortable with AI tools, and energised by solving messy problems end to end, this role is for you.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
Strategy & Problem Framing
  
  

* Help founders frame weekly and monthly priorities: what matters, why now, and what success looks like.
* Turn open-ended questions into crisp problem statements, options, and recommendation memos.
* Support competitive, market, and customer research that informs product and growth bets.
* Track strategic initiatives from idea → decision → owner → next milestone.

Data Analysis & Insights
  
  

* Pull, clean, and analyse product, growth, and operational data to answer founder questions quickly.
* Build lightweight dashboards, scorecards, and recurring insight notes (what changed, why it matters, what to do).
* Validate hypotheses with evidence (not vibes) and flag risks, anomalies, and opportunities early.
* Translate analysis into clear visuals and one-page briefs founders can act on.

Product Management Support
  
  

* Support discovery: user interviews, feedback synthesis, journey mapping, and opportunity sizing.
* Help write PRDs, specs, acceptance criteria, and release checklists for priority initiatives.
* Coordinate across design, engineering, and go-to-market to keep scope, timelines, and dependencies visible.
* Run QA / dogfooding passes, document bugs/edge cases, and close the loop after launches.

AI Optimisation & Workflow Design
  
  

* Identify repetitive Founder Office and team workflows that AI can compress or improve.
* Design and document prompts, agents, and SOPs for research, writing, analysis, QA, and reporting.
* Experiment with tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Notion AI, spreadsheet copilots) and measure time saved / quality lift.
* Help the team adopt better AI habits: templates, evaluation checklists, and versioned workflows.

Operational Support
  
  

* Own follow-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, and decision logs so nothing important falls through.
* Coordinate cross-functional projects: timelines, owners, blockers, and weekly status updates.
* Support special projects spanning hiring ops, partner outreach, content briefs, or launch readiness as needed.
* Create durable systems (docs, trackers, checklists) that make the company faster after you leave each workstream.

What success looks like
  
  
Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:
  
  

* Deliver founder-ready memos and analyses that lead to clear decisions.
* Own at least one end-to-end workstream from problem framing to measurable outcome.
* Ship useful AI workflows that reduce cycle time for recurring Founder Office tasks.
* Keep priorities, owners, and next actions visible across the initiatives you support.
* Demonstrate strong judgment: escalate early, communicate crisply, and improve with feedback.

Who you are
  
  

* Final-year undergraduate / postgraduate student or recent graduate (any rigorous major; preference for business, economics, CS, design, or quantitative fields).
* Strong analytical and written communication skills. You can turn complexity into clarity.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic data analysis; SQL / Python / BI tools are a plus.
* Hands-on with modern AI tools and eager to invent better ways of working.
* Structured operator: you track details, close loops, and hate dropped balls.
* High ownership and bias to action in ambiguous environments.
* Available full-time (or near full-time) for 3–6 months; based anywhere in India (IST or a similar timezone).

Bonus points
  
  

* Prior internship in startups, consulting, product, analytics, or strategy.
* Personal projects, campus clubs, or research where you owned outcomes, not just tasks.
* Experience writing specs, running user interviews, or shipping a small product/feature.
* Fintech, consumer apps, or personal-finance curiosity.
* Design fluency (Figma/Canva) or light engineering fluency.

Why join us
  
  
You will work directly with founders at an early-stage fintech building AI-native money products: rare exposure for an internship.
  
  
You will learn how strategy, product, data, and operations connect in practice, not in a textbook.
  
  
High performers will leave with a portfolio of real decisions influenced, workflows built, and outcomes shipped, and a strong path to a full-time conversation if there is mutual fit.

title: Specialist, Quality Engineer
description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
**Role Summary**
**Specialist QA Engineer — Job Requirements**
We are seeking a Specialist QA Engineer to strengthen quality across web applications, APIs, and integrated services. The role requires hands-on API and performance testing, alongside test automation, observability practices, and CI/CD integration to help teams deliver reliable software at pace.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in software quality engineering, including designing test strategies and translating requirements into clear, risk-based test coverage.
* Strong programming experience in at least one of: Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain automated test code.
* Practical experience developing browser automation with Playwright and/or Selenium; able to create maintainable, reusable tests and troubleshoot failures.
* Experience applying the Page Object Model (POM) or an equivalent page/component abstraction to organize UI automation.
* Experience with BDD-style testing and Cucumber, including writing or maintaining readable feature scenarios and step definitions.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and tools such as Harness; familiarity with Rancher-based environments is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience designing and executing API tests for REST and SOAP services and validating integrations, including systems built with Mule or MuleSoft; able to verify functional behavior, error handling, and end-to-end flows across dependent services.
* Hands-on experience planning and executing performance and load tests using JMeter, analyzing results, identifying bottlenecks, and communicating performance risks and findings.
* Experience with database testing, including data validation and verification of application-to-database behavior; familiarity with Oracle Database and relational and non-relational database concepts.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, New Relic, and Splunk (or equivalent platforms) to investigate test and production issues.
* Experience using AI prompting to support QA work, such as generating or refining test scenarios, test data ideas, and defect-analysis summaries; able to validate AI-generated output for accuracy, security, and suitability before use.
* Familiarity with Jira for managing test-related work, tracking defects, and communicating status within a delivery team.
* Experience working within Agile methodologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams through planning, refinement, execution, and retrospectives.
* Strong defect investigation, root-cause analysis, test reporting, and communication skills; able to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and operations teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building AI agents is a plus.
* Experience supporting test automation in containerized or Kubernetes environments, including deployments managed with Rancher.
* Experience combining UI, API, integration, and performance testing in a cohesive quality strategy.
* Familiarity with test data management, mocking/stubbing, parallel test execution, and reducing flaky tests.
* Experience contributing to continuous-delivery quality gates and release-readiness decisions.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Automated tests are maintainable, useful, and integrated into delivery pipelines.
* Test results provide actionable feedback, and defects are identified early with clear evidence and reproducible steps.
* Performance and observability signals are used to help teams diagnose risk and improve service reliability.

**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
As a Quality Engineer you will plan and conduct a wide range of software quality tests and analyses to ensure all application products and services meet organizational standards aligned to their quality management approach, as well as, end-user requirements. All Quality Engineers perform quality planning, quality design and execution.
  
  
You will focus on a blend of skills enabling efficient execution of risk-based testing, test automation, performance testing, test data management, test environment management, continuous integration and continuous deployment all improving speed to delivery for our business partners.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Carries out procedures to ensure all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements.
* Analyses and reviews moderate requirements, user stories and technical work products to create the automation needed.
* Applies secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Plans for the proper mix of manual, automated, and exploratory testing methods.
* Uses the appropriate quality engineering tools to define test data management, test automation, security/vulnerability, performance, and regression testing needs.
* Validates test results, records and researches defects.
* Coordinates test runs and test environment calendars for all impacted applications.
* Traces requirements to tests and test results.
* Prioritizes, defines, and manages defect reporting and resolution.
* Manages defects including identifying, tracking, and providing critical thinking for resolution.
* Identifies means to be more effective and efficient in testing, without compromising quality.
* Plans for continuous integration to enable a continuous deployment pipeline.
* Executes moderate release testing and has a plan for back-out testing.
* Validates that release components are installed in the appropriate testing environment.
* Aligns with the Nationwide automated testing reference architecture.
* Complies with release management process governance and timelines throughout the release.
* Additional responsibilities may include collaboration across teams and adherence to company standards.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or a related field is preferred.
  
  
**License/Certification/Designation:**
Technology certifications including TOSCA Automated Specialist 1 (AS1), TOSCA Automated Specialist 2 (AS2), or other related designations are preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Four or more years of related experience with software delivery or educational experience within a technology domain. Demonstrated experience in testing for agile teams including planning, test plan creation, maintenance and execution. Understanding of test automation and optimization throughout a stack and the tools to support.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Agile Methodology
* Analytical Thinking
* Business Processes
* Business Requirements
* Computer Science
* Detail-Oriented
* Test Automation
* Test Planning

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Time management and prioritization
* Ability to problem solve and set priorities needed. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus.

**Additional Information**
**Reporting Structure:**
Reports to Technology Leader – India
  
  
**Working Hours**
Aligned to India business hours with flexibility for global collaboration.
  
  
**Location Flexibility:**
[Hybrid/Remote/In-office] with periodic in-office collaboration.

Nationwide is committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, disability, religion, or other protected categories.

Strong experience with automated testing and test-driven development
  
  

* Detailed understanding of smoke testing, functional, and non-black box testing, as well as regression testing

* Expert and hands on with backend test automation using Rest Assured/Karate for API testing. JDBC/JPA for database testing (Oracle/ DB2/ Snowflake).
* Experience in Software Development

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.

IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.

Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.

**Role**

We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cross-Team Dependency & Complex Delivery Management**

* Own and drive resolution of cross-team technical dependencies across 8–12+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform-level dependencies across squads

**Delivery & Release Governance**

* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no-go criteria, and sign-off processes
* Oversee end-to-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization

**Technical Programme Leadership**

* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross-team planning, and programme-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity
* Drive PI Planning and large-scale increment coordination across product and platform squads

**Stakeholder & Executive Engagement**

* Serve as the primary delivery interface for senior stakeholders, CTO, and executive leadership on complex programmes
* Produce clear, data-driven programme status reports, risk dashboards, and delivery forecasts for leadership review
* Translate complex technical interdependencies into business-level impact narratives for non-technical audiences
* Proactively manage expectations, surface trade-offs, and recommend delivery options under constraint

**Tooling & Delivery Intelligence**

* Own and evolve programme-level Jira structures including epics hierarchies, dependency links, cross-project boards, and automation
* Drive delivery intelligence through advanced metrics: cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, dependency resolution SLAs.
* Build and maintain executive-level dashboards that surface programme health, risk, and delivery confidence
* Ensure tooling practices support audit readiness and compliance requirements in a regulated financial services environment

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* 10+ years in Technical Delivery Management, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership roles
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi-team technical programmes in a regulated or high-stakes environment
* Deep expertise in cross-team dependency management across large engineering organizations (8+ teams)
* Strong technical fluency; ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects, and platform teams on technical trade-offs
* Extensive experience with Agile at scale frameworks and hybrid delivery models
* Advanced Jira administration, programme-level workflow design, and delivery metrics expertise
* Proven experience driving complex release governance across distributed, parallel workstreams
* Experience working in fintech, trading platforms, or high-frequency, regulated product environments strongly preferred
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast-paced, high-complexity environment

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Associate, Financial Systems Program Management**
Be part of a dynamic team at the center of the Firm’s finance-led systems, where you'll help turn business needs into impactful technology solutions. In this role, you'll collaborate with finance, technology, and global stakeholders, gain visibility with leadership, and develop valuable project management and analytical skills while supporting a portfolio of strategic enterprise initiatives.

* Provide coordination and operational support for finance systems enhancements and changes across the portfolio

Hyderabad

2 PM to 11 PM

Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree

* Knowledge of project management fundamentals, including milestones, risks, issues, actions, decisions, dependencies, and status reporting

* Experience supporting enhancement intake, prioritization, or program management coordination

* Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or Scrum delivery approaches

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Lead Engineer - Embedded SW Development
description:

As a Lead Engineer – Embedded SW Development (LPB2), you will be a technical cornerstone in the development and evolution of the MarkVIe control platform. Operating within a global, cross-functional environment, you will drive the design, implementation, and optimization of firmware for state-of-the-art power generation control systems. * Technical Leadership: Translate high-level system requirements into robust firmware architectures and low-level design specifications.
* Full-Cycle Development: Lead the design, coding, testing, and debugging of mission-critical system software for the MarkVIe platform.
* Performance Optimization: Analyze and enhance the efficiency, stability, and scalability of system resources to meet stringent power generation requirements.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 5-8 years of professional experience in embedded software programming, with a demonstrated ability to perform hands-on development and complex troubleshooting on embedded targets.
* Technical Proficiency:

+ Advanced C/C++ programming skills.
+ In-depth understanding of microprocessor architectures.
+ Hands-on experience with preemptive, multitasking Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), with a strong preference for QNX.

* Methodologies: Proven experience in Agile development environments and automated unit testing for C/C++.
* Toolsets: Proficiency in software configuration management tools, defect tracking systems, and peer-review processes.
* Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven track record of working effectively in global, multi-functional teams.

* Domain Expertise: Direct experience with MarkVIe control systems firmware development.
* Protocol Knowledge: Experience working with industrial communication protocols (e.g., MODBUS, Profibus, Profinet, Foundation Fieldbus, CAN, Industrial Ethernet).

* Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading global programs and mentoring junior engineers.
* Versatility: Exposure to C# development for tooling or utility applications is a strong plus.
* Initiative: A self-starter mindset with the ability to navigate complex, cross-functional technical challenges autonomously.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Scrum Master is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for guiding and coaching teams in the use of Scrum / Agile practices.
  
  
The primary responsibility of this role is to boost the effectiveness of teams by managing key projects, championing cross team alignment and delivering success and operationalizing underlying processes to make development teams hum effectively.
  
  
The Scrum Masters resolves impediments, monitors and has control over the scrum processes and meetings.

* Fosters a self-organizing and empowered environment that enables teams to deliver high-quality products on time and within budget.
* Facilitates and leads Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

* Fosters effective communication and collaboration between cross-functional teams, product owners, and stakeholders.
* Acts as a bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring a shared understanding of the project goals, priorities, and timelines.

description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**The Role:**
Scrum Master
  
  
**The Team:**
Our Technology Governance & Delivery Enablement team at S&P Dow Jones Indices is responsible for establishing effective portfolio planning and execution patterns in order to drive operational excellence and fostering a culture of collaboration through lean portfolio management and enabling agile ways of working. As a member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating our technology delivery leveraging agile and lean principles.
  
  
**The Impact:**
We are looking for a motivated individual who is ready to take their career to the next level. This person will play a pivotal role in guiding the teams to adopt Agile practices and methodologies starting with mindset shift to deliver prioritized business value. This person will be responsible to facilitate one to two Scrum teams with focus on team dynamics, continuous learning and agile maturity across teams and ART(s). This person will be responsible for removing any impediments to help the teams achieve their iteration/sprint goals and PI objectives. Will work closely with the Product Manager, Product Owner, Tech leads, UI/UX, security, QE leads and other team members to make sure the product/solution/platform development meets the business needs, aligns with product roadmap and prioritization.
  
  
**The Career Opportunity:**
This role offers immense potential for growth and professional development in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. You will enjoy the open, transparent culture and the opportunity to:
  
  

* Be part of global teams to deliver innovative solutions to the market
* Further enhance your agile, collaboration and delivery skills with focus on building team’s agility within a large organization
* Build relationships and engage with stakeholders across the organization, managing stakeholder expectations to deliver the best solution

**Responsibilities:**
  
  

* Coach teams on Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and built-in quality practices.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and PI Planning; guide the team through draft planning, backlog readiness, blocker identification, dependency coordination, risk resolution, and team objective alignment to broader OKRs in partnership with other Scrum Masters and the RTE.
* Remove impediments, proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and improve team flow using Agile metrics; take accountability for timely escalation and resolution of risks, blockers, and bottlenecks that impact iteration goals and PI objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement, self-organization, decision-making, and conflict resolution.
* Create a trusted and safe team environment where team members can openly share inputs, surface concerns, and collaborate constructively while supporting effective decision-making and conflict resolution.
* Represent the team in Scrum-of-Scrums, ART Syncs, Value Stream Syncs, and other cross-team forums; coordinate with Scrum teams, ARTs, RTEs, Product Owners, Product Managers, and technical leads to communicate dependencies, improve transparency, and ensure delivery alignment.
* Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Technical Leads to maintain a healthy backlog by ensuring MVPs, features, and user stories are clear, concise, prioritized, and aligned to business goals, product roadmap, and team readiness.
* Generate and maintain Agile dashboards and metrics that support data-driven decisions, transparency, predictability, and continuous improvement; promote adoption of AI/GenAI practices, including the effective balance of digital and human teams, use of AI agents in team ways of working, and application of GenAI across product and development lifecycles.

**What we are looking for:**
  
  

* 12–15+ years of industry experience, including 5–6 years as a Scrum Master across product teams.
* Experience working in SAFe, value streams, and Agile Release Trains.
* Strong facilitation, conflict resolution, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement skills.
* Ability to understand domain-specific and technical discussions to facilitate Agile events, dependency conversations, risk reviews, and team decision-making in a meaningful way.
* Proven ability to improve Agile execution, delivery predictability, quality, and business value.
* Proven track record of enabling teams to deliver prioritized business value efficiently with a focus on accelerated delivery, enhanced quality, measurable outcomes, and maximum ROI.
* Expertise in Agile metrics, Kanban practices, lean portfolio management, and enterprise software delivery lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Confluence, Power BI, MS Teams, SharePoint, JIRA, or VersionOne.
* Excellent organizational, statistical, analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and oral presentation skills.
* Exposure to AI capabilities in Scrum and SAFe practices.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in finance, business management, information technology, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
  
  

* Financial industry experience preferred.
* SAFe Scrum Master 6.0 certification required; SASM, PSM, CSM, APM, or CTC certifications are a plus.
* Prior Agile Coach experience and familiarity with BDD, ATDD, TDD, CI/CD, pair programming, automation, and Kaizen preferred.

**Overall Characteristics:**
  
  

* Assertive, industry-aware, and confident in guiding teams on Agile/Scrum principles, SAFe 6.0, Scrum/Kanban with AI-enabled practices, and built-in quality; able to act as a voice of reason and authority, make tough calls, and ensure Agile principles are consistently applied.
* Self-starter who promotes strategic alignment and is methodical, detail-oriented, efficient, organized, and highly productive.
* Creates transparency by bringing the right level of disclosure to appropriate forums, stakeholders, and leadership to build trust and support timely decisions.
* Comfortable using AI to improve productivity, decision-making, and team/product outcomes.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs that require strong planning, cross-team coordination, and disciplined execution? Deloitte is seeking a Senior - Technical Program Management (TPM) professional to drive integrated engineering schedules, manage dependencies, identify delivery risks early, and help ensure business commitments are met across global technology initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with product, engineering, and leadership teams to bring structure, transparency, and operational rigor to enterprise-scale delivery.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior - Technical Program Management (TPM) on the GES Technology Group team, you will be responsible for coordinating engineering delivery plans, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution across one or more domains.
  
  

* Own and maintain integrated engineering schedules for assigned domains, including milestones, delivery dates, and schedule updates tied to product and engineering decisions
* Track and manage dependencies across teams, domains, and product areas; facilitate issue resolution to reduce delivery blockers and improve execution visibility
* Identify and monitor risks related to scope, resources, dependencies, and execution; maintain mitigation plans and escalate unresolved issues with context and recommendations
* Partner with product owners, product managers, engineering managers, and leadership teams to align priorities, capacity, milestones, and delivery commitments
* Develop domain knowledge across architecture, release cadence, team structure, and workstream impacts to assess schedule changes and support informed delivery decisions

**The team**
At Deloitte Tax LLP, the Global Employer Services (GES) Technology Group helps multinational clients develop programs, processes, and digital offerings to manage global workforce needs and compliance obligations tied to mobility, business travel, and remote work. The team partners with go-to-market teams and global clients to solve business and technology challenges, design digital experiences, and build products that support compliance with global and local regulations.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management or engineering program management within software product environments
* Experience owning integrated engineering schedules across multiple teams, including milestones, delivery dates, and dependency tracking
* Experience managing cross-functional dependencies across engineering teams, product teams, platforms, or domains
* Experience working with software development life cycle models, including Agile, Scaled Agile Framework, or hybrid delivery methodologies
* Experience identifying, documenting, and escalating delivery risks related to scope, resources, dependencies, or execution
* Experience translating product scope and priority decisions into engineering delivery plans and status reporting

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with cloud architecture or multi-tier application environments
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable program tracking tools
* Project Management Professional or SAFe Agilist certification
* Knowledge of SOC 2 standards or data privacy regulations, including General Data Protection Regulation

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. title: IT&D Manager, Smart Execution
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded IT&D Manager to lead the Smart Execution capabilities of the Sales Execution platform globally. The primary role is to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the technology teams, owning the roadmap of the solution and manage the on-going deployment and adoption within the markets. The ultimate objective is to deliver insights which create value and drive business forward in the space of route-to-market, in-store execution and sales excellence, whilst ensuring synergy, cost effectiveness and appropriate levels of data governance.
  
  
This candidate will need to demonstrate an effective communication and delivery skillset and collaborate confidently with mid-senior levels of the organisation. We are looking for someone who can innovate, with the ability to encourage performance and motivate peers and the wider organisation to embrace advanced data & analytics capabilities.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Capability Management
  
  

* Define and own the feature roadmap for the Smart Execution capabilities, including RTM, Routing, In-store Execution and Order Recommendations
* Gather and translate business requirements from commercial and sales teams into technical user stories and acceptance criteria
* Prioritize backlogs and make decisions aligned to the business value
* Partner with the technology teams, data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and application developers to deliver the capabilities
* Manage the full technology lifecycle — from discovery and design through build, testing, and deployment
* Drive adoption of the Smart Execution capabilities across Sales (Retail Management, Key Account Management), Trade Marketing and Customer Supply, ensuring tools are effectively utilized to achieve business objectives
* Monitor usage and identify opportunities for improvement and enhancement
* Utilize a deep understanding of FMCG categories and external data to inform development and deployment strategies
* Work closely with other teams within Sales Execution Platform for a seamless integration of AI within existing workflows
* Manage vendor relationships, including implementation partners

Stakeholder Engagement:
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all stakeholders of capabilities managed, building and maintaining strong relationships, and driving adoption
* Manage and communicate Roadmaps, providing details of delivery timelines, training and deployment to regional and market users
* Collaborate with and provide expertise and support to market teams, developing action plans based on analytical insights, refine processes and unlock new capabilities

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  
  

* Partner with Global and Regional commercial teams to develop analytics best practices, maintain and deliver these in the markets in alignment with the IT operating model
* Work with other Global IT&D Managers within the Sales Execution team to ensure alignment and leveraging the synergies between teams
* Ensure alignment of the technical delivery with the Reckitt’s data analytics platform - Trinity data architecture standards, patterns and principles. Align changes where necessary
* Implement solutions aligned to global IT&D enterprise architecture frameworks

The experience we're looking for
  
  
6-8+ years in business analysis, data science consulting or IT Management (with exposure to AI Product Management)
  
  

* Proven experience in designing, deploying and adopting analytical tools within commercial teams
* Experience in working with the Sales functions
* Preferred experience for role:
* FMCG / Consumer Goods experience preferred
* Previous hand-on Data Science experience preferred
* Exposure to Modern Trade and/or Pharmacy/OTC sales channels

The skills for success
  
  

* Technical Skills
* Familiarity with Sales Execution solutions or platforms
* Familiarity with Azure tech stack and Microsoft Power Platforms
* Ability to guide AI model development, managing trade-offs between data availability, model accuracy and business value delivered
* Ability to evaluate model performance and translate model outputs into business insights to drive stakeholder buy-in
* Designing experiments to measure value delivered and inferring/extrapolating results
* Delivering end-to-end ad hoc analyses including scoping, problem translation, solution design and insights generation
* Awareness of impact of solution architecture and solution design choices on infrastructure requirements
* Ability to write or review functional specifications
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and cross-functional team collaboration

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strong grasp of Sales Execution levers: execution compliance, on-shelf availability, MSL, share of shelf etc.
* Ability to translate commercial strategy and processes into design and decisions

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent stakeholder management across senior commercial and IT leadership
* Strong communication — able to speak both “business” and “tech”
* Analytical mindset with comfort around large datasets

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

Hyderabad, India (Hybrid – 3 days in office)
  
  
**About Nasuni**
Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world’s unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.

**Software Engineering Manager – Cloud Services**

* Experience building scalable backend services or data-processing systems.
* Experience leading Agile software development teams.

* Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical engagement with team leadership.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development productivity.

title: Lead - Ground Systems Software Engineering
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced
**Lead / Manager - Ground Systems Software Engineering**
to lead the architecture, development, integration, deployment, and lifecycle of mission-critical Ground Systems for command and control, telemetry, mission operations, situational awareness, monitoring, and data distribution.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in software engineering, systems integration, cloud-native and real-time distributed systems with strong delivery leadership, guiding multidisciplinary teams and cross-functional partners to build reliable, scalable, secure, high-performance solutions.

The role also drives technical strategy, architecture governance, resource and talent planning, risk management, and successful program execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Software Development & Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of Ground System software applications and services.
* Define technology roadmaps and software engineering best practices for Ground Systems.
* Drive architecture reviews, design governance, and technical decision-making across programs.
* Ensure software solutions meet performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security requirements.
* Champion modern software engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, containerization, and microservices-based architectures.
* Establish coding standards, development frameworks, and software quality assurance processes.

**Ground Systems Integration**

* Oversee integration of software with telemetry systems, communication networks, databases, mission systems, sensors, and external interfaces.
* Lead system integration, verification, validation, and operational readiness activities.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, network, infrastructure, and systems engineering teams.
* Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of complex software and integration issues.
* Ensure seamless deployment and operational transition of Ground System solutions.

**Program Delivery & Project Management**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Ground System software projects from concept to deployment.
* Develop project plans, resource allocation strategies, and execution roadmaps.
* Monitor project schedules, technical milestones, budgets, and deliverables.
* Manage technical risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful program execution.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 12-18+ years of software engineering experience.
* Minimum 3-5 years of technical leadership or engineering management experience.
* Proven experience leading large-scale software development and integration projects.
* Strong programming expertise in:
* Python, C/C++, Java (Preferred), Scripting Languages, Linux/Unix environments.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps/DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD frameworks.
* Expertise in Git-based development environments and software configuration management.
* Strong knowledge of communication protocols including:
* TCP/IP, UDP, Qt, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, RS-232, RS-422, RS-485
* Experience in software architecture, distributed systems, and system integration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Principal Engineer Software
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in our Identity Security division, you will be the ultimate technical authority and go-to expert for our core Single Sign-On (SSO) and Federation capabilities. You will own the architectural integrity, security posture, and scalability of our SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) implementations. In this role, you will balance deep technical execution with organizational leadership—driving best practices across microservices, mentoring engineering teams, representing our identity expertise externally, and pioneering the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance our identity security capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures.
* Architect resilient, low-latency microservices capable of handling millions of token validations, federation requests, and authentication flows globally.
* Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles.
* Partner with data science teams to integrate AI/ML models into authentication flows for real-time risk scoring and anomalous token behavior detection.
* Advocate for and embed generative AI development tools into the team's daily workflows to safely accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
* Lead large-scale features, protocol refactors, and microservice optimizations, ensuring alignment with the company’s Tech Radar and security baselines.
* Identify architectural gaps in SSO services, advocate for improvements, and implement robust solutions.
* Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration.
* Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness.
* Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* The candidate should have experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#/.NET OR Java OR Python .The candidate should be willing to work with the C#/.NET technology stack.
* Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities.
* Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value.
* Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
