title: Specialist Scrum Master - DTI Marketing
description:
The Specialist Scrum Master serves as a servant leader and Agile coach for one or more Scrum teams. This role is responsible for enabling high-performing teams through effective facilitation, coaching, impediment removal, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence. The Specialist Scrum Master partners closely with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Architects, and business stakeholders to maximise value delivery and accelerate Agile maturity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Agile Leadership & Coaching
  
  

* Coach teams on Scrum principles, Agile practices, and servant leadership.
* Foster self-organisation, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Help teams mature in Agile delivery practices and product thinking.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote psychological safety.

Scrum Facilitation
  
  

* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, Refinements, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies remain outcome-driven and focused on value delivery.
* Drive effective backlog refinement and sprint goal alignment.

Impediment Management
  
  

* Identify, track, and facilitate removal of team and organisational blockers.
* Escalate risks and dependencies when necessary.
* Enable teams to proactively address impediments rather than creating dependency on the Scrum Master.

Delivery Excellence
  
  

* Monitor Sprint health, team velocity, predictability, and flow metrics.
* Support forecasting, release planning, and delivery commitments.
* Drive adoption of Agile metrics to improve performance and predictability

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritised backlog.
* Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to align delivery objectives.
* Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies transparently.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Lead meaningful retrospectives resulting in actionable improvements.
* Drive process optimisation initiatives across teams.
* Promote Lean and Agile best practices throughout the organisation

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Agile environments.
* 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software delivery teams.
* Deep understanding of Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent Agile tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Scrum teams.
* Experience in scaled Agile environments (SAFe, LeSS, Nexus).
* Knowledge of Agile metrics, flow efficiency, and Lean product delivery

Success Measures
  
  

* Improved sprint predictability and delivery reliability.
* Reduced delivery impediments and cycle time.
* Increased team engagement and Agile maturity.
* High stakeholder satisfaction.
* Continuous improvement actions implemented and sustained

title: Scrum Master/BA III, Commercialization
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Assignment Summary**
The Scrum Master / Business Analyst III partners directly with the hiring manager to establish the agile operating model for assigned teams within Commercial Data & AI, working with program managers to embed consistent agile ways of working and automating operational and delivery metrics reporting. The assignment is accountable for sprint health and delivery predictability, while maintaining lightweight requirements and backlog continuity for assigned teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner directly with the hiring manager to define and establish the team's agile operating model — ceremonies, cadences, roles, and ways of working — for assigned teams within Commercial Data & AI.
* Work with program managers across Commercial Data & AI to establish and embed consistent agile ways of working, aligning practices and standards across teams.
* Automate operational and delivery metrics reporting — velocity, capacity, throughput, predictability, risks, and dependencies — turning raw delivery data into a reliable, self-updating leadership narrative.
* Automate recurring coordination activities such as status reporting, dashboard updates, ceremony preparation, dependency tracking, and routine follow-ups using approved AI and automation tools.
* Own Agile delivery governance for assigned teams, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-functional ceremonies, with accountability for team health and delivery predictability.
* Actively coach assigned teams on Agile principles and practices, building durable agile maturity rather than simply running ceremonies.
* Apply automation to routine backlog hygiene, traceability updates, and status tracking to reduce manual overhead and improve consistency.
* Apply established Jira and Confluence standards for assigned teams, including board configuration, workflows, permissions, dashboards, and documentation.
* Identify and drive resolution of impediments, risks, and cross-team dependencies before they affect delivery timelines or quality.
* Oversee vendor delivery quality and adherence to agreed ways of working for vendor-staffed capacity supporting assigned teams, escalating material gaps through the appropriate BMS owner.
* Maintain lightweight ownership of requirements quality for assigned teams — user stories, acceptance criteria, and backlog traceability — sufficient to keep backlog items build-ready.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Experience partnering directly with a hiring manager or delivery lead to stand up or significantly reshape a team's agile operating model, not only operating within an existing one.
* Experience working with program managers to establish or harmonize agile ways of working across multiple teams.
* Hands-on experience automating operational and delivery metrics reporting (velocity, capacity, throughput, predictability) using approved AI or automation tools.
* Strong knowledge of Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or equivalent, with a demonstrated ability to build agile maturity in a team, not just facilitate ceremonies.
* Advanced Jira proficiency and working Confluence proficiency, including workflows, dashboards, permissions, and documentation standards.
* Solid requirements and backlog-quality fundamentals — user stories, acceptance criteria, traceability — sufficient to keep delivery moving without deep domain ownership.
* Ability to translate delivery data into clear updates for domain stakeholders, technical teams, and senior leadership.
* Facilitation, coaching, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills across global, matrixed teams, including vendor-supported delivery models.
* Ability to onboard quickly, work independently, navigate ambiguity, and deliver effectively in a time-bound contingent assignment.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.
* 7+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role, ideally with a track record of establishing agile operating models and automating delivery coordination, not only running ceremonies.
* Experience partnering with program managers or portfolio leads to align agile practices and ways of working across teams.
* Experience working with vendor-supported delivery capacity and maintaining adherence to team standards and expected outcomes.
* Experience working across US, India, and other global locations in Agile or product-based delivery environments.
* Hands-on experience applying AI or automation tools to delivery coordination, reporting, or documentation workflows is strongly preferred.
* Preferred certifications include CSM, SAFe, Jira Administration, PMP, PRINCE2, CBAP, or equivalent.

description:

**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Position Summary:**
**Role: Delivery Management Engineer II**
Deliver high-quality work products within established timelines while helping Agile teams improve how they plan, execute, and deliver work. As a Delivery Management Engineer II, you will serve as a Scrum Master for product and engineering teams, facilitate Scrum practices, support team effectiveness, and help remove barriers to delivery. You will also work with stakeholders, Product Owners, and delivery teams to promote transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle, while supporting the adoption of artificial intelligence-enabled engineering practices within the pod.

As a Delivery Management Engineer II on the Engineering-as-a-Service team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Facilitating Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Coordinating delivery across multiple pods, including facilitating Scrum of Scrums and managing cross-team dependencies
* Coaching Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and development teams on Scrum practices, backlog management, team accountability, and continuous improvement
* Tracking sprint and delivery metrics, maintaining Scrum artifacts, and building dashboards that communicate progress, risks, and delivery status to stakeholders
* Removing impediments and supporting backlog refinement, prioritization, sprint goals, and delivery planning across hybrid and distributed teams
* Supporting adoption of artificial intelligence-enabled engineering tools and flexing into adjacent delivery activities such as requirements clarification, release coordination, or quality assurance coordination as pod needs evolve

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. **Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM and 2 PM to 11 PM**

Required:
  
  

* 4+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar Agile role, working in a POD model and facilitating collaboration across multiple PODs through events like Scrum of Scrums
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, especially Scrum and scaled Agile environments (SAFe)
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Experience working with cross-functional teams catering to complex business environments operating at scale in hybrid work environments
* Understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC), including project planning and estimation, risk identification, and capacity and dependency resolution
* Ability to coach and mentor team members on Agile and Lean delivery practices and product delivery tools such as Jira boards; comfortable leading role-based trainings for Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and development teams
* Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills, collaborating with Scrum teams to achieve faster impediment resolution and dependency mitigation
* Proficient in Agile project management tools (Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally), with experience building dashboards to enhance transparency of delivery metrics
* Ability to enable teams to deliver value by leveraging flow metrics, Objectives & Key Results (OKRs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Basic understanding of version control systems (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), CI/CD processes, and release management
* Basic understanding of key deployment strategies (e.g., A/B testing, canary releases, blue-green deployment, rolling deployment)
* Exposure to, or genuine curiosity about, GenAI tools in software engineering (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar AI coding assistants)
* BE / B.Tech / M.C.A. / M.Sc. (CS) degree or equivalent from an accredited university

description:
As a Business Systems Analyst within our global Commercialization Technology team, this role will help evolve Commercialization portfolio decision intelligence and governance operations capabilities. Come join a team that is passionate about innovation and making life better with technology!
  
  
This position will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions. The successful candidate will help shape product requirements and processes, evaluate technology and data capabilities, and support the delivery of solutions across our evolving technology landscape. This role will also contribute to the adoption of AI and emerging technologies, data visualization and analytics, and effective data management practices while helping ensure that solutions meet business, security, and operational needs.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Product Owners and System Architects to manage business analysis activities, ensuring alignment with business and product goals
* Understand customer needs to shape business processes and product requirements
* Work with Product Managers and customers to define scope and value for new developments
* Collaborate with Business SMEs and Product Management to prioritize release scopes and refine the Product backlog
* Ensure non-functional requirements are included and prioritized in the Product and Release Backlogs
* Facilitate the breakdown of Epics into Features and Sprint-Sized User Stories and participate in backlog reviews with the product team
* Clearly express features in User Stories/requirements so all team members and stakeholders understand how they fit into the product backlog
* Ensure Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done are well-defined and understood
* Stay focused on software development to ensure it meets requirements, providing proactive feedback to stakeholders
* Develop and execute effective product demonstrations for internal and external stakeholders
* Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, processes, and changes

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5 to 9 years of information systems experience as a business analyst
* Demonstrated experience serving as an information systems business analyst supporting enterprise software or data solutions
* Ability to independently deliver moderately complex technical assignments while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team
* Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technologies, platforms, and business processes
* Eagerness to learn and grow in a software development environment

**Functional Skills:**
**Must-Have Skills**

* Experience with writing user requirements and acceptance criteria in agile project management systems such as JIRA
* Hands on experience with project management and business analysis concepts
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies and ability to drive projects using Agile methodology
* Experience evaluating technology solutions and platforms, assessing capabilities, risks, integration considerations, and alignment to business needs
* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to improve business processes, decision-making, or user experiences
* Experience with data visualization and analytics solutions, translating complex data into clear and actionable insights for business stakeholders
* Working knowledge of data management concepts, including data quality, governance, integration, lineage, and lifecycle management
* Experience providing support to IT system users, including troubleshooting production issues, providing training, and participating in incident response
* Working knowledge of application security concepts, including authentication, authorization, and access controls
* Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery methodologies
* Ability to create clear technical documentation, including designs, diagrams, configuration instructions, and operational support procedures
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders and collaborate across global, virtual, and cross-functional teams

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Experience serving as a business analyst supporting enterprise-grade software to production within a global, highly regulated, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environment
* Experience with stakeholder management, ensuring seamless coordination across teams and driving the successful delivery of technical projects
* Experience in managing product features for PI planning and developing product roadmaps
* Experience with data visualization in PowerBI, Tableau, etc
* Able to communicate technical or complex subject matters in business terms
* Experience of DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery methodology. Experience with Jira Align is a plus
* Experience supporting applications or business stakeholders with technologies such as Salesforce, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, AWS, or GitLab
* Familiarity with secure software development and delivery management practices
* Working understanding of business operations in one or more of the following Drug Development Life Cycle areas: Research and Development, Commercialization, Operations, Process Development, Commercial, or Marketing
* Experience working with geographically distributed development teams, vendors, business stakeholders, or managed-service providers
* Relevant certifications in cloud technologies, software development, data engineering, DevOps, cybersecurity, Agile, or enterprise platforms

**Professional Certifications:**

* Agile (preferred): SAFe for Teams certification or equivalent
* Project Management (preferred), for example: Project Management Professional, Certified Associate in Project Management, or equivalent
* Business Analysis (preferred), for example: PMI Professional in Business Analysis, Certification of Capability in Business Analysis, Certified Business Analysis Professional, or equivalent

**Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional collaboration and communication skills
* High degree of initiative and self-motivation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully
* Team-oriented with a focus on achieving team goals
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills

title: Senior Product Analyst, Product Management
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Position:**
Senior Business Analyst, Product Management
  
  
**Location**
: Hyderabad, India
  
  
At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care. If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
  
  
The Product Analyst – Product Management will play a crucial role in supporting data-driven decision-making processes, generating insights, and providing strategic guidance to optimize business operations across Research and Development Business Insights and Technology. This position requires expertise in forecasting, decision support, research, statistical analysis, real-world data analysis, digital analytics, and measurement. The Business Analyst will collaborate with cross-functional teams and utilize advanced analytical techniques to enhance business performance and drive growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Acting as primary liaison between the cross-functional teams and all the stakeholders. The person in this role must make sure the information flow is quick and clear so that there is no misinterpretation.
* Communicate with all stakeholders and come up with right KPIs for the project success.
* Drives ROI and Values.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business objectives and identify opportunities for the application of generative AI solutions.
* Being responsible for maximizing the value of the product and the work of the Development Team. Take input from all stakeholders’ funnels through him or her to guide in the creation and prioritization of the Product Backlog.
* Providing clear understanding of what those items mean (in both function and value) aids in maximizing the efforts of the Development Team.
* Works closely with Product owners and technical leads to ensure clean and clear requirements and smooth delivery.
* Maintaining the team backlog – With input from TechLead/Architect/Engineering (Development) Team and other stakeholders.
* Product Analyst – Product Management reviews and reprioritizes the backlog as part of the prep work for Sprint Planning, including coordination of dependencies with other Projects.
* Communicates story details and priorities and ensures the team aligns and agrees on a final iteration plan.
* Ensure that AI solutions adhere to regulatory guidelines and BMS standards, addressing any compliance issues.
* Experience in Visualize the Business Process Flows using Visualization Tools - MS Visio or Lucid Chart etc.,
* Work closely with developers as part of the agile development team to translate user stories to working applications.
* Manage user acceptance testing, training, and change management associated with roll out of automation solutions.
* Prepare Techno - Functional User Manuals for end users.
* Develop and maintain business requirements, user stories, and other documentation as required by BMS Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and software validation processes.
* Provide functional guidance to developers, testers, and other stakeholders to ensure that technological solutions are implemented correctly and are maintained effectively throughout their lifecycle.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends and act as a catalyst and champion for innovation in Life Sciences Industry
* Conduct analysis and interpretation of complex data sets to derive meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Prepare reports, dashboards and presentations to communicate findings, insights and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels of the organization
* Stay up to date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies
* Provide training, guidance and mentorship when required

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in business analysis, process mapping, solution development and delivery for AI & ML Technologies in Automation
* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies, experience with agile development methodologies
* Knowledge in Pharma Document Generation
* Good to have knowledge of Python and cloud services.
* Knowledge of AI/ML/ Gen AI solutions desired (e.g., Data science projects, AI, ML, NLP, Generative AI (OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and other LLMs))
* Experience in working with real-world data (including clinical and healthcare), large datasets, data visualization tools.
* Domain (Pharma background must) - Possessing general awareness and knowledge of regulatory, legal, or quality requirements (e.g., privacy regulations, GxP) impacting the business, and ensuring solution requirements include appropriate key points.
* Strong understanding of generative AI concepts and technologies.
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Any of the Certifications like - Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner will be good along with exposure on Business Analysis

*If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.*

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
**Aptagrim**
designs, engineers and deploys specialised enterprise AI products and intelligent workflow systems. Our systems are built around how a business actually works: its knowledge, its decisions and its day-to-day operations.

We are a growing team at an early stage. You will shape how we deliver, not just follow an existing playbook, and the AI systems you ship will run inside real enterprise operations.

**The role**

We're hiring a hands-on
**Technical Delivery Manager**
with deep Python and Django experience. You will own the delivery of enterprise applications and AI solutions, from discovery to production rollout.

This is a technical leadership role, not a task-tracking one. Expect to spend about 25–30% of your time hands-on: reviewing code, designing backend systems, unblocking engineers and building critical pieces or proofs of concept yourself. The rest goes to delivery ownership, client relationships, planning and team leadership.

**What you'll do**

**Delivery ownership**

* Own delivery end to end: lead discovery, scoping, estimation, planning, build, testing, client acceptance, deployment and handover to support.
* Plan realistically: set milestones, dependencies and acceptance criteria that account for technical uncertainty, data readiness and client inputs. Spot risks early and act on them.
* Control scope and economics: assess the effort, schedule and commercial impact of change requests. Track utilisation, budgets and project margins, and correct course when they drift.
* Run multiple engagements: balance engineering, QA, DevOps and business analysis capacity across projects, working with the Project Coordinator on tracking and reporting.

**Technical leadership**

* Lead backend engineering: guide the design of scalable, secure and maintainable systems in Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including APIs, data models, background processing and enterprise integrations.
* Stay hands-on: review code, debug hard production and performance issues, and build critical components or proofs of concept when the team needs it.
* Integrate AI into products: work with the Head of AI's team to bring LLM, retrieval and agent capabilities into production applications, with sound data flows, failure handling and monitoring.
* Set the quality bar: establish practical standards for testing, code review, documentation, security, observability and release readiness, and own production readiness: deployment, rollback, monitoring and incident response.

**Clients and team**

* Own client communication: run delivery reviews, explain technical trade-offs in plain language, set expectations (including around AI accuracy and iteration) and resolve escalations.
* Support pre-sales: turn business requirements into solution options, estimates, assumptions and statements of work.
* Grow the team: mentor engineers and tech leads, help hire, delegate well, and use retrospectives to make estimates and delivery steadily more predictable.

**What you'll bring**

* 7+ years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in technical leadership with ownership of client-facing delivery.
* Deep, recent, hands-on Python and Django: Django REST Framework, object-oriented design, application architecture and production troubleshooting. You still write and review code regularly.
* Strong backend fundamentals: REST API design, authentication and role-based access, PostgreSQL (schema design, ORM, indexing, query tuning, migrations), and async processing with task queues and caching (for example, Celery and Redis).
* Production engineering: testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, Docker, Linux and deployment on a major cloud, plus security, secrets management, logging, monitoring and incident investigation.
* A track record of delivering enterprise applications from requirements through deployment and client acceptance.
* Delivery and commercial skills: estimation, planning, risk and scope management, effort forecasting, and managing budgets and margins.
* Clear communication: you can explain technical problems to non-technical stakeholders and handle difficult client conversations calmly.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery, applied pragmatically rather than by the book.

**Nice to have**

* Experience shipping LLM-based features to production, such as RAG pipelines, agent workflows, prompt and output evaluation, or LLM API integration
* Experience delivering projects where data quality, model accuracy or non-deterministic outputs shaped the plan
* Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure services beyond basic deployment

title: Digital Products Manager
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Digital & Innovation group at USP is seeking a Product Manager who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  

* Core analytics capabilities include the ability to instrument critical metrics, identify the landscape of the entire function, determine opportunities for improvement, work with Product to craft scalable solutions, and monitor their performance.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Experience**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis or Technical Program Management, delivering scalable software services and platform features.
* Lead large-scale technology programs including scope definition, project planning, prioritization, execution tracking, and successful delivery.
* Create, maintain, and manage detailed project schedules, resource allocations, dependency maps, and technical documentation.
* Conduct readiness assessments across people, processes, systems, and technology components to ensure delivery alignment.
* Develop program baselines, perform gap analyses, drive reviews, and implement updates to ensure strong execution governance.
* Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies; implement effective mitigation strategies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather functional and technical requirements, align deliverables, and ensure milestone readiness.
* Prepare comprehensive project artifacts including dashboards, status reports, timelines, risk registers, and delivery plans.
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings, document key decisions, capture action items, and drive closure on follow-ups.
* Monitor project performance, proactively escalate blockers, and ensure timely issue resolution to maintain delivery cadence.
* Partner with engineering, product, operations, and geographically distributed teams to achieve program objectives.
* Provide clear and consistent reporting on KPIs, milestones, risks, and deliverables to leadership and stakeholders.
* Define program scope, develop feature specifications and user stories, and work closely with engineering teams for implementation.
* Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to design optimal, scalable, and forward-thinking solutions.
* Demonstrated experience delivering cloud-scale systems and driving deep technical conversations when needed.
* Lead effective program ceremonies and working sessions, assign and track action items, and ensure project visibility.
* Drive software engineering and data initiatives with a strong understanding of the technical and business ecosystem.
* Influence stakeholders across multiple teams and levels to drive alignment and program success.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity with strong ownership, adaptability, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g. Engineering, Analytics or Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics) or equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Experience in scientific nomenclature or hands-on experience in life sciences, chemistry, pharmaceuticals, or related STEM fields; science-related degree preferred.
* Proven track record of taking ownership and driving technical projects to successful completion.
* Excellent organizational skills; strong attention to detail and ability to lead by example and display growth mindset.
* Industry standard certifications such as CSPO, SAFePOPM, ITIL, PMP etc. would be a plus

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
None, this is an individual contributor role.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
**Job Category**
Information Technology
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Hyderabad, reporting to the Director of Software Engineering. You will join the Engineering team that built the world’s largest cloud security platform from the ground up. As a leader in our multitenant architecture, you will bring your vision and passion to help organizations worldwide harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Understand how to build and operate high scale systems
* Provide service and product wide architectural guidance, and drive impactful technical decisions
* Establish and enforce best practices for coding, testing, observability, and CI/CD pipelines to maintain high-quality, production-ready services
* Drive cross-team collaboration and lead initiatives in performance optimization, reliability improvements, and adoption of new technologies/tools to accelerate feature velocity

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain and experience with agentic AI systems and orchestration workflows
* 2+ years of experience in Java coding in a highly distributed and enterprise-scale environment
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure services on AWS or Azure
* Strong experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture
* Strong database knowledge of SQL constructs and data modeling
* Strong experience with Identity governance and administration, Access Management

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience leveraging AI coding assistants, automated code review tooling, or LLM-assisted development workflows to optimize software architecture and accelerate delivery cycles
* Experience building reliable data tiers using Postgres, Redis, Terraform, Ansible, graph databases like Neo4j or AWS Neptune, and developing GraphQL APIs
* Knowledge of identity and access management systems (Okta, SAML, OAuth), test automation, Python programming, and designing fault-tolerant distributed systems for networking or cloud security products

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

description:

title: Quality Engineering Lead – Data Validation & Automation Expert (AI Enabled)
description:
**Designation: QA Lead - Data Validation Expert**
**Experience:**
8–12 Years
  
  
**Job Function:**
Digital Assurance / Quality Engineering
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Job Summary**
Blumetra Solutions is looking for an experienced QA Lead – Data Validation to lead quality engineering initiatives across enterprise data integration, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data platforms, and analytics solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SQL, data validation, API testing, end-to-end system integration testing, and test automation. The role requires ownership of QA strategy, quality governance, customer coordination, and delivery stage gates. Experience leveraging AI-powered development tools such as Claude to build, deploy and maintain test automation utilities and QA accelerators is highly desirable.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* QA Strategy & Leadership: Define and drive end-to-end QA strategies, test plans, test coverage, capacity planning/ estimations, and quality engineering standards for complex data projects.
* Data Validation: Lead validation with hands-on across data integrations, ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers), semantic models, dashboards, and visualizations.
* SQL & Data Reconciliation: Review and develop complex SQL queries to validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, transformation logic, and source-to-target reconciliation.
* API & System Integration Testing: Drive API testing, end-to-end testing, and system integration testing across interconnected applications, services, and data platforms.
* Test Automation: Design and govern scalable automation frameworks using Python, Playwright, API automation tools, and other suitable technologies.
* AI-Assisted QA Engineering: Use Claude and other AI-powered tools to build and enhance validation utilities, automation accelerators, and reusable QA components. Leverage AI where appropriate for test preparation, RCA, summary reports and other documetation. Own automation utility/ scripts maintenance, version control, and deployment.
* Data Lineage & Metadata: Ensure appropriate validation of metadata, data lineage, transformation logic, and data movement across systems and architectural layers.
* Cloud & Data Platforms: Lead testing initiatives involving AWS or Microsoft Azure and Snowflake-based data solutions.
* Quality Governance & Stage Gates: Define and enforce QA entry and exit criteria, stage-gate checklists, release readiness assessments, defect closure requirements, and quality sign-offs.
* Defect Management: Drive defect triage, root-cause analysis, prioritization, resolution tracking, and risk communication.
* QA Documentation & Reporting: Review and maintain test strategies, test cases, requirements traceability matrices (RTMs), execution reports, defect reports, and test summary reports.
* Customer & Stakeholder Management: Work closely with customer teams, business stakeholders, developers, data engineers, and project managers to manage expectations, resolve issues, and ensure successful delivery.
* Team Leadership: Mentor QA engineers, review test deliverables, improve team productivity, and promote reusable frameworks and best practices.
* Agile Delivery: Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning using Jira and related tools. Ensure Story/ task detailing with right level of acceptance criteria, calling out dependencies and risks upfront.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in QA, data testing, data validation, or quality engineering, including relevant leadership experience.
* Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and database testing.
* Proven experience in data integration testing, ETL/ELT validation, source-to-target reconciliation, reports testing.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, Medallion Architecture, semantic models, and visualization testing.
* Expertise in API testing, end-to-end testing, and system integration testing.
* Experience designing or governing automation frameworks using Python, Playwright, and API automation tools.
* Practical experience using Claude or equivalent AI-powered tools for code generation, automation development, and maintenance.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake and at least one cloud platform: AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of metadata, data lineage, and cross-system data flows.
* Experience owning QA governance, stage-gate reviews, test sign-offs, and release readiness.
* Strong customer-facing communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* Retail and Supply Chain domain experience is preferred.
* Life Sciences domain experience is an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
A hands-on QA leader who understands business problem, has depth in domain/ functionality, combines technical depth in data validation and automation with the ability to own quality governance, lead team, engage customer, and ensure reliable data delivery across complex enterprise data ecosystems.
  
  
Skills: data validation,automation,data,testing

Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
The Scrum Master is a key member of an Agile team, responsible for facilitating the Scrum process, coaching team members in Agile best practices, and ensuring the team’s effectiveness in delivering high-quality products. The Scrum Master acts as a servant leader, removing impediments and fostering a collaborative, transparent, and high-performing team environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
As a Delivery Management Engineer III on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for supporting Agile delivery execution, enabling team effectiveness, and helping drive high-quality outcomes across POD-based delivery environments.
  
  

* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives.
* Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum, Agile practices, and scaled Agile ways of working to support effective delivery.
* Remove impediments, manage dependencies, and help resolve delivery risks impacting sprint execution.
* Support backlog refinement, prioritization, and communication of delivery goals in collaboration with Product Owners and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Track sprint progress, delivery flow, and quality metrics, while preparing status updates and maintaining Scrum artifacts to promote transparency.

**The team:**
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM; 2 PM to 11 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar Agile delivery role supporting POD-based delivery models and collaboration across multiple PODs, including Scrum of Scrums.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience applying Scrum and scaled Agile frameworks, including SAFe, in software delivery environments.
* Experience with software development life cycle, project planning and estimation, risk identification, and capacity and dependency management.
* Experience using Agile project management tools, including Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, or Rally, and building dashboards to report delivery metrics.
* Experience coaching Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and development teams on Agile practices, Lean delivery practices, and product delivery tools.
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science from an accredited university, or equivalent degree.

Preferred:
  
  

* SAFe Agilist certification.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in enterprise-scale delivery environments.
* Experience tracking sprint plan, definition of done, quality, and delivery flow metrics.
* Experience supporting backlog refinement and backlog management with Product Owners.
* Experience with version control systems, including GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket, and continuous integration, continuous deployment, and release management processes.
* Experience using objectives and key results and key performance indicators to measure Agile team performance.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. **EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
This role leads a team providing agile methodology services to cross-functional technology-related project(s) or product(s) teams, demonstrating technical expertise to improve productivity of teams and quality of work processes and outcomes. Project(s) or product(s) often have enterprise-wide implications. This role also ensures agile best practices are embedded in delivery, manages stakeholder alignment, and drives team performance through metrics and continuous feedback.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Leads, builds, and coaches high performing teams in the delivery of technology-related products or projects, ensuring team actions are aligned with project and business goals. Instruct and coach other professionals.
* Leads planning, team learning, and adaptation of processes to ensure the quality of team solutions.
* Enables a continuous learning environment, identifying ways to strengthen the team's understanding of Agile/Scrum concepts and principles as they relate to technical capabilities.
* Builds and applies methodology that supports the integration of changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology-related product development.
* Recommends to the product owner and management in the definition and prioritization of technology-related outcomes. Identifies trade-offs between short and long term benefits to drive shared vision between the team and product owner.
* Ensures the application of agile frameworks to the development process to increase effectiveness of technology-related product development or architecture.
* Removes roadblocks to technology-related product development or architecture. Applies learnings to other development projects.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages stakeholder expectations regarding target scope, schedule, and budget.
* Helps teams estimate iteration deliverables and increase sprint velocity.
* Acts as a Subject Matter Expert for agile methodologies and best practices.
* Promotes continuous communication and monitors team dynamics to foster collaboration.
* Facilitates scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, demos, and iteration meetings.
* Manages development tracking systems (e.g., product and sprint backlogs).
* Motivates and acts as the glue that holds cross-functional teams together.
* Monitors sprint progress and identifies impediments that hinder delivery.
* Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive monitoring and alerting to proactively identify performance degradation and application disruptions
* Perform end to end triage and in depth troubleshooting of production incidents by analysing logs, telemetry signals, and related diagnostic data to quickly identify root causes and restore service
* Design and build ML models that analyse telemetry, logs and metrics to predict and prevent incidents before they impact users.
* Implement best in class detection mechanisms to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and accelerate incident response
* Develop systems that learn from historical incidents, continuously improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerate incident response time
* Build innovative, scalable alerting solutions across a heterogeneous technology landscape, including AWS, Unix, and Mainframe platforms.
* Develop and maintain synthetic monitoring to simulate real user interactions and ensure early detection of failures.
* Perform daily health checks, triage and troubleshoot alerts, and resolve issues to minimize downtime and user impact.
* Conduct trend analysis, identify recurring patterns, and partner with application teams to enhance system reliability and availability
* Lead and participate in standard incident management processes, leveraging incident playbooks, diagnostic tools, and technical expertise to quickly identify impact and restore service
* Proactively trigger incident management when early signals indicate potential disruption
* Review and act on maintenance notifications, service advisories, and platform updates to mitigate operational risks.
* Maintain a centralized incident response playbook, ensuring steps, processes, and escalation paths are clearly documented.
* Document incidents, recovery steps, and learnings, and communicate them to relevant stakeholders to drive continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with application (App) development teams to identify, diagnose, and resolve operational problems impacting the platform or applications.
* Act as a bridge between platform operations and development teams to ensure timely root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Work collaboratively with developers, DevOps engineers, and IT stakeholders to improve performance, reliability, and operational maturity.
* Continuously refine alerting to reduce false positives and false negatives.
* Stay current with emerging observability tools, monitoring strategies, and SRE practices.
* Promote and support adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across teams.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned
* Willingness to work in a 24×7 support model, as needed

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in Agile software development, with at least two years leading large cross-functional teams on enterprise technology initiativesBachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field is required; graduate degree preferred.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification (mandatory); AWS Solutions Architect certification preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years of hands on experience as an operations engineer, full stack developer, or automation engineer.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Good to have skills include Agile team leadership, stakeholder management, sprint planning, backlog prioritization, velocity optimization, and use of agile tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps. Strong skills in collaboration, verbal and written communication, team motivation, time management, and critical thinking are essential.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, PMI-ACP, or ICAgile Certified Professional.
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing agile teams, remove delivery blockers, and foster a culture of continuous improvement in fast-paced, enterprise-level environments.
* Experience working with Confluence.
* Experience monitoring and refining dashboards.
* Experience in continuous process improvement for process flows and workflows.

**Required Skills:**

* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability collaborating with application teams, ability to handle escalations and troubleshoot complex application issues.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting logs to generate operational intelligence and accelerate incident resolution.
* Experience with observability, SRE principles, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve system reliability.
* Expert level knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* Experience with REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems
* Strong tooling and automation skills using Python, Java, Selenium etc.
* Prior experience in incident management and stakeholder communication.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies.
* Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools such as Honeycomb, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or other similar tools
* Background in supporting Java-based applications on AWS, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and deployment support.
* Experience with additional monitoring and visualization tools such as Splunk, Grafana, and ThousandEyes.
* Exposure to Unix and Mainframe environments.
* Experience in networking and troubleshooting connectivity issues
* Experience building AI/LLM-powered applications (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent frameworks
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, IT Delivery
description:

Works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems. Acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Mid-Level Developer understanding and hand-ons experience with Java/Python, AWS Services, CI/CD Pipelines (Github, Bitbucket, Bamboo) TDD/BDD practices
* User level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb, Cloud Watch, Open Telemetry; Understands observability concepts
* Well versed in Confluence, JIRA
* Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering Tools (Claude Code, Github CoPilot) effectively to improve the software development process. Ability to mentor/coach others on the team on the effective use of AI Tools
* High Level understanding of automated testing concepts
* Previous people leadership experience. Ability to lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers. Ability to set clear performance expectations, provides ongoing feedback, and supports career growth.
* Demonstrated ability to drive delivery outcomes and implement strategic platform initiatives.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in software development and enterprise IT solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams and managing stakeholders.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Software Engineering Manager-Insights Application
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead and coach a team across backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps, production support, and release validation responsibilities.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for a production web application environment built around .NET / C#, APIs, React / Redux, current Azure services, and modern CI/CD practices, while leading the team's cloud migration to AWS.
* Help define the next-generation direction for the Insights application, including modernization, architecture, AWS target-state design, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity with AI-assisted tooling such as Cursor.
* Own delivery execution across roadmap work, technical debt, operational improvements, incident response, release readiness, and production support.
* Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, QA, DevOps, Support, and business stakeholders to translate priorities into clear technical plans, backlog decisions, acceptance criteria, and delivery outcomes.
* Improve engineering practices across code quality, review discipline, automated testing, observability, release management, incident learning, service-level objectives, and responsible use of AI coding tools including Cursor.
* Support transition and long-term ownership of complex or partner-built application components into full-time team accountability.
* Strengthen application reliability across multi-tenant architecture, customer access models, background processing, messaging, integrations, and data platform dependencies.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Recent hands-on experience designing, building, reviewing, and operating production web applications; this is not a people-only management role.
* Strong technical background in .NET / C#, API development, React or comparable SPA frameworks, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience leading engineering teams through delivery planning, technical decision-making, production support, and release execution.
* Working knowledge of the current Azure production stack (App Service, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Entra ID, or comparable services), plus hands-on AWS experience to lead and execute the platform migration to AWS.
* Hands-on AWS experience with production application workloads (for example EC2 / ECS / EKS / Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS / SNS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and AWS-aligned CI/CD), including cloud migration or platform cutover experience.

title: SAP Test Manager
description:
Job Description: SAP Test Manager / Test Lead
  
  
**Position:**
SAP Test Manager / Lead
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience Level:**
Senior Level
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Test Manager / Test Lead**
to oversee and manage end-to-end testing activities across complex SAP implementation and rollout programs. In this role, you will define comprehensive test strategies, coordinate test planning and execution, and drive quality assurance standards. You will leverage
**SAP Cloud ALM (CALM)**
and
**Jira**
for complete test lifecycle management, defect tracking, and governance while serving as a primary point of contact for key client stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Strategy & Planning: Design, implement, and maintain overall SAP Test Strategies, Test Plans, and Governance Frameworks tailored to client requirements and project scope.
* Test Execution Management: Drive end-to-end test phases including Integration Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Cutover / Go-Live testing.
* Tool & Process Management: Utilize SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira to create test cases, track execution progress, manage defects, build quality dashboards, and deliver regular status reports to senior management.
* Stakeholder Management: Manage direct relationships with client leadership, functional leads, business users, and third-party vendor teams to align on test scope, schedules, risks, and acceptance criteria.
* Defect & Risk Governance: Facilitate daily defect triage meetings, establish clear SLAs for defect resolution, manage escalation paths, and proactively address quality risks to keep project schedules on track.

**Required Qualifications & Mandatory Skills**
  
  

* SAP Testing Leadership:

+ Proven expertise as an SAP Test Manager or Test Lead with a strong track record in Test Strategy, Test Planning, Test Coordination, and Test Execution Management across SAP landscapes.

* Tools Expertise (CALM & Jira):

+ Hands-on proficiency with SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) and Jira for end-to-end test planning, defect management, metrics tracking, and governance reporting.

* Client-Facing & Stakeholder Management:

+ Exceptional customer-facing communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated experience interacting with client executives, managing business expectations, and facilitating user training/UAT sessions.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Test Automation: Exposure to or experience with automated testing tools and methodologies within SAP environments (e.g., TOSCA, Worksoft Certify, Selenium, or native SAP automation capabilities).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Leadership skills with a collaborative approach to leading cross-functional delivery teams.
* Capability to thrive in high-pressure project delivery environments.
