title: Engineering Manager, AI & Cloud Solutions
description:
The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading and developing a team of engineers delivering cloud-native and AI-enabled solutions. This role combines people leadership with technical oversight and hands-on implementation, providing guidance, coaching, and support to engineering teams while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The manager partners closely with stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of technology solutions, supports technical decision-making, and helps teams navigate complex and evolving business challenges.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading and developing a team of engineers delivering cloud-native and AI-enabled solutions. This role combines people leadership with technical oversight and hands-on implementation, providing guidance, coaching, and support to engineering teams while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The manager partners closely with stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of technology solutions, supports technical decision-making, and helps teams navigate complex and evolving business challenges.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, mentoring, and career development support for engineers and technical team members.
* Partner with engineering teams to guide technical decisions, remove delivery obstacles, and ensure alignment with established engineering standards and best practices.
* Support the successful delivery of cloud-native applications, AI-enabled solutions, APIs, and technology platforms.
* Contribute to implementation as needed, including writing and reviewing code, building prototypes and proofs of concept, and resolving complex technical issues alongside the team.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to understand priorities, align resources, and drive execution against strategic goals.
* Foster a culture of innovation, knowledge sharing, accountability, and continuous learning across the team.
* Help teams manage competing priorities and make timely, effective decisions in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
* Monitor team health, delivery progress, operational performance, and key outcomes, identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Support workforce planning, resource allocation, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning activities.
* Ensure adherence to security, risk management, compliance, and technology governance standards.
* Encourage adoption of modern engineering practices, automation, cloud technologies, and AI-driven solutions where appropriate.
* Build strong partnerships across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups and effectively communicate team priorities, progress, and outcomes.
* Participate in strategic initiatives and other leadership responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams in a technology-driven environment.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud-native application development, and technology delivery.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud technologies, AI/LLM-powered solutions, APIs, and modern application architectures.
* Hands-on proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, GitHub, deployment pipelines, and Agile development practices.
* Experience supporting technical decision-making, solution delivery, and engineering execution across multiple initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop engineers while fostering a positive and inclusive team culture.
* Experience operating in ambiguous environments and helping teams navigate change, uncertainty, and evolving priorities.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Technical leader with a strong engineering foundation and a passion for developing people.
* Comfortable guiding teams through complex technical and business challenges and contributing directly to implementation when needed.
* Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and a growth mindset.
* Encourages innovation and experimentation while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Thrives in fast-paced environments and brings a proactive, ownership-driven approach to leadership.
* Builds trust, develops talent, and creates an environment where teams can perform at their best.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. **Physical wellness**

**Personal wellness**

**How We Work**

We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

As an experienced Scrum / Agile practitioner, you are responsible for managing the overall dependencies across multiple programs in a value stream. You should have very strong domain, business and technical knowledge along with exceptional communication and facilitation skills. You are responsible for managing dependencies and stakeholders across multiple Programs during the release and should be able to handle the complexities across 10-15 Scrum teams during the release and coordinate across the same. * Interface with SoSMs and help manage the dependencies of scrum teams across single/multiple programmes

* Highlight the risk and dependencies across all programs in the LOB to ensure achievement of release goals. Resolve impediments to ensure smooth sprint execution
* Resolve and further escalate impediments across teams to a minimum and ensuring ZERO impact on the overall Release schedule
* Responsible for CSAT as per organization norms and expectations. Ensure EWS, customer escalations and escalation resolution as per organization norms
* Enabling collaboration between Dev, Ops and other stakeholders to ensure availability of required environment
* Interact with Agile Line Manager to resolve internal impediments related to people and operations
* Expand the Wipro footprint / ensure repeat business in the LOB
* Communicate team success to client and Wipro stakeholders and leadership
* Participate in CoP initiatives in Wipro / account

* Responsible for performance management of SoSMs, Technical / System Architects, Product Owner and Agile Line Managers

͏ ͏

.

.

title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member IV - Guidewire PolicyCenter
description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Provides guidance, mentorship and training to a direct reporting staff of Agile Dev team members. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are architecturally sound, high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and little to no guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Define and execute tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad and deep level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**
Demonstrates customer needs by interpreting into viable solutions and contributes significantly to the system design. Effectively breaks down features and write and refine user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. Execute Test-Driven (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology to evaluate work. Supports implementation activities, troubleshoot user/system environmental issues and training. Supports the business in building a Lean Business case and breaking epics into features. Identify and raise issues and risks with functional design and offer alternative solutions. Works with the Product Owner to confirm the code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a development discipline: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components in multiple applications; configures packaged software. Provides expertise in the solution design and functionality of business applications. Reviews and validates application technical design of team members to ensure alignment with business needs and best practice architecture principles. Analyzes and evaluates existing manual and computerized systems/procedures to improve efficiency. Researches and develops techniques for automation. Documents and implements programs according to installation standards and conventions. Analyzes and makes recommendations on the need for system backup, security, restart/recovery, balancing & controls and recommends approaches for meeting such needs. Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Delivers working code each sprint. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirement for testability by utilizing advanced testing tools. Develops, documents, executes and maintains test cases and test data. Identifies complex errors that occur in application testing and analyzing results to trouble shoot and execute root cause analysis. Reports the status of the test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Conducts audits to ensure test planning and execution adheres to standards and guidelines. Defines advanced test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. Demonstrates ability to write test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation and train others. Contributes to the overall test strategy. Provide input in the development of application quality and testing standards and best practices. Demonstrate working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos. Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. Demonstrates ongoing thirst for knowledge and a desire for continuous improvement. Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. Creates an environment where knowledge and best practices are shared and fosters a culture of continuous learning and relentless improvement. Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. Conducts research, design, prototyping and other exploration activities which fosters innovation and builds alignment between the customer need and what is delivered. Offers and implements innovative ideas within multiple areas of focus. Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP) and builds a cooperative spirit and elicits maximum participation from each group member. Encourages group members to take ownership of the process and the outcomes. Able to plan and conduct CoP sessions. Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions. title: Specialist IS Business Systems Analyst - R&D  PPM
description:
As a Business Systems Analyst within our global Commercialization and R&D PPM Technology team, this role will help evolve R&D PPM (Project and Program Management) capabilities. Come join a team that is passionate about innovation and making life better with technology!
  
  
In this vital role, you will apply systems, data, and business-process expertise to translate business needs into clear product and system requirements. You will define epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, use cases, data requirements, and test scenarios that enable delivery teams to estimate, plan, and deliver with confidence.
  
  
You will support Project and Portfolio Management (PPM), including Planisware-enabled planning, technology assessments, AI enablement, roadmap development, and data-management activities, using structured, consulting-style problem solving to help stakeholders make informed technology and investment decisions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will work closely with R&D PPM subject matter experts, process owners, data owners, Product Owners, developers, data engineers, architects, UX designers, QA teams, portfolio leaders, and external partners to ensure applications, data, analytics, portfolio, and AI-enabled solutions meet business, functional, quality, and compliance expectations.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Product Owners and System Architects to manage business analysis activities, ensuring alignment with business and product goals
* Understand customer needs to shape business processes and product requirements
* Lead structured technology assessments covering business fit, technical fit, architecture alignment, integration and data impacts, security and compliance, cost, risk, scalability, vendor considerations, and implementation readiness; translate findings into decision-ready options, recommendations, business cases, and phased roadmaps.
* Identify and shape AI-enablement opportunities by defining use cases, value hypotheses, data-readiness needs, workflow impacts, responsible-AI considerations, adoption plans, human oversight, and measurable outcomes.
* Develop and maintain integrated product, technology, and capability roadmaps aligned with R&D PPM strategy, business priorities, investment decisions, dependencies, and delivery milestones; support PI planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, release planning, and delivery sequencing.
* Support Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) processes in Planisware, including demand intake, portfolio planning, prioritization, scenario analysis, resource and capacity planning, dependency management, milestone tracking, and portfolio reporting.
* Partner with portfolio and product stakeholders to improve PPM governance, Planisware data quality, reporting consistency, decision support, and adoption.
* Ensure functional and non-functional requirements are documented, traceable, and prioritized in product and release backlogs.
* Clarify requirements, resolve gaps, and facilitate alignment when SMEs or stakeholders have conflicting needs.
* Define and advance data-management practices for ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, quality, lineage, access, lifecycle, master and reference data, and governance.
* Work with data engineers, architects, analytics teams, and data owners to ensure data products meet business needs and are usable, trusted, scalable, and compliant.
* Collaborate with Business SMEs and Product Management to prioritize release scopes and refine the Product backlog
* Facilitate the breakdown of Epics into Features and Sprint-Sized User Stories and participate in backlog reviews with the product team
* Clearly express features in User Stories/requirements so all team members and stakeholders understand how they fit into the product backlog
* Ensure Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done are well-defined and understood
* Stay focused on software development to ensure it meets requirements, providing proactive feedback to stakeholders
* Develop and deliver product demonstrations, assessment readouts, roadmap updates, business cases, and recommendations for business, portfolio, SME, and technical stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate documentation of requirements, assumptions, decisions, processes, assessments, roadmaps, user stories, and changes.
* Use Planisware, Jira, Confluence, and related Agile and PPM tools to manage portfolio information, requirements, backlogs, defects, decisions, and delivery activities.
* Work within Agile and Scaled Agile environments to deliver incremental business value.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual activities and improve portfolio management, requirements, testing, data management, and delivery processes undefined

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree and 8-13 years of experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Data, or a related field.

**Functional Skills:**
**Must-Have Skills**

* Extensive experience in business systems analysis, product analysis, or requirements engineering.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) processes, including portfolio planning, prioritization, roadmapping, resource and capacity planning, scenario analysis, and reporting.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with business and technical SMEs to elicit, clarify, validate, and document complex requirements.
* Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder-management, and executive-communication skills.
* Consulting-style skills in structured problem solving, hypothesis-driven analysis, option evaluation, recommendation development, executive-ready communication, and influencing without authority.
* Demonstrated experience leading technology assessments and translating complex findings into options, trade-offs, recommendations, business cases, and implementation roadmaps.
* Ability to translate specialized R&D, process, portfolio, data, and technology knowledge into clear functional, data, and technical requirements.
* Experience writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process maps.
* Experience developing and supporting product, technology, and capability roadmaps, including PI planning, prioritization, dependency management, delivery sequencing, backlog refinement, and user journeys.
* Experience defining data, analytics, reporting, KPI, dashboard, and portfolio-management requirements.
* Understanding of data management and governance, including data ownership, stewardship, metadata, mapping, validation, business rules, reconciliation, lineage, data quality, access, and lifecycle management.

* Knowledge of R&D processes, systems, operational data, and analytics.
* Experience working with R&D SMEs, process owners, product teams or portfolio-management offices.
* Experience configuring, integrating, administering, or supporting Planisware in an enterprise environment.
* Experience in technology strategy, management consulting, internal consulting, transformation, or enterprise advisory work.
* Familiarity with Databricks, data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, and enterprise data architectures.

* Experience with monitoring and visualization tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve portfolio analysis, roadmap development, requirements documentation, process analysis, testing, and business productivity.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are seeking a strong Sr. Scrum Master who can help with an organizations SAFe Agile Transformation, supporting global technology and business teams. As an Sr. Scrum Master, you will play a critical role in driving the adoption and implementation of SAFe Agile methodologies across the organization. You will work closely with teams and stakeholders to foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and high performance. Your expertise will help us accelerate our product development cycles, improve quality, and deliver innovative solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for Product Team motivation and innovation. Must have the ability and experience to push, drive, and motivate the product teams for completing all work according to the business value. Must continuously be two steps ahead of the team, and stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scrum Facilitation:**

* Guide and coach multiple Scrum teams on the adoption and implementation of Agile/Scrum practices.
* Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure that Scrum practices are followed, and team members understand and adhere to Agile principles.

**Team Support And Development**

* Serve as a mentor and coach to Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and team members.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to experiment, learn, and adapt their processes.
* Support the development of team members by providing feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and promoting professional development.

**Impediment Removal**

* Identify and address any impediments that may hinder the team's progress.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to remove obstacles and ensure smooth project execution.
* Escalate issues when necessary to ensure timely resolution.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Owners and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, priorities, and deliverables.
* Facilitate effective communication between the development team and stakeholders.
* Assist in the development and management of product backlogs, ensuring they are well-groomed and prioritized.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and remove impediments that hinder Agile adoption and team productivity.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging teams to experiment, learn, and adapt their processes.
* Ensure teams maintain compliance with pharma regulatory requirements, including GxPwhere applicable.

**Metrics And Reporting**

* Track and analyze key performance metrics to assess team performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide regular reports on team progress, sprint outcomes, and overall project status to stakeholders.
* Utilize data-driven insights to recommend and implement process improvements.

**Agile Advocacy**

* Promote Agile principles and practices across the organization.
* Lead training sessions and workshops to educate teams and stakeholders on Agile methodologies.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging Agile practices and introduce new ideas to the organization.

**Ceremonies/Events**

* Daily Stand-up
* Backlog Refinement (Grooming)
* Sprint Planning
* Sprint Retrospectives
* Demo's
* UAT's

**Tools**

* Jira / Jira Align
* Smartsheet
* Confluence
* MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
* OneNote
* WebEx
* Miro

**Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of experience working with Agile methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
* Demonstrated success as a Scrum Master for newly forming teams, guiding them from startup to maturity.
* Experience working in large-scale organizations with global, multi-geographic team structures.
* Proficiency in Agile collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or Rally.
* Advanced communication and facilitation skills with ability to influence and collaborate across organizational levels.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional dependencies and navigate complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Pharma or life sciences experience preferred, particularly in regulated environments (e.g., GxP).
* PI Planning (Quarterly Planning) experience required.
* Agile certifications such as SAFe Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent certification are required.
* Familiarity with pharma-specific projects and product delivery lifecycles.

**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Senior Specialist, Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist, Data Analysis**
**The Opportunity**
Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology-driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  
This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for Senior Specialist with strong Functional analysis, data analysis, functional testing, UAT coordination, stakeholder communication, and Scrum Master responsibilities for one or two squads. Understand business data needs and perform descriptive and investigative analysis across relevant solution-delivery phases. Query, explore, and validate data to identify patterns, anomalies, quality issues, business rules, and functional impacts. Work with Value Team Business Analysts and Product Managers to translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and validation requirements. Support functional testing and UAT to confirm delivered solutions and data outputs meet agreed business requirements. Serve as Scrum Master for one or two squads by enabling Agile ceremonies, backlog readiness, impediment removal, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Analyze and validate data from relevant databases and sources to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and business impacts.
* Write SQL queries for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, defect analysis, functional testing, and root-cause assessment.
* Triage data questions, defects, and functional issues; communicate findings clearly and coordinate with teams through resolution.
* Partner with Value Team Business Analysts and Product Managers to clarify business processes, requirements, and expected outcomes.
* Convert requirements into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, test scenarios, and traceability artifacts.
* Ensure functional specifications are complete, testable, aligned to business priorities, and ready for squad implementation.
* Define and execute functional test scenarios using data analysis and SQL where appropriate.
* Coordinate functional testing across business, QA, and technology teams, including test-data readiness, execution tracking, defect clarification, and retesting.
* Support UAT planning, business-user coordination, execution guidance, defect management, evidence collection, and business sign-off.
* Validate delivered functionality and data outputs for quality, timeliness, compliance, and user experience.
* Act as Scrum Master for one or two squads; facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work with Product Owners and Product Managers to maintain a prioritized, ready backlog with clear acceptance criteria.
* Help squads remove impediments, manage dependencies, maintain delivery transparency, and achieve sprint goals.
* Track sprint progress, risks, actions, dependencies, and improvement commitments; provide concise updates to stakeholders.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships and collaborate effectively across global teams and matrix organizations.

**What Should You Have**

* 8+ years of experience
* Data analysis and investigative problem solving
* SQL query writing for extraction, validation, reconciliation, testing, and root-cause analysis
* Data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality assessment
* Functional analysis and functional specification writing
* User story, acceptance criteria, business rule, and process-flow definition
* Functional testing and requirement-to-test traceability
* UAT planning, coordination, defect clarification, retesting, evidence collection, and sign-off support
* Scrum Mastery and Agile ceremony facilitation
* Backlog readiness, dependency tracking, impediment removal, and delivery transparency
* Stakeholder relationship management across business, product, QA, and technology teams
* Clear written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences
* Global matrix collaboration and influencing without direct authority
* SQL and relational databases
* Data-analysis and data-validation techniques
* Agile work-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent
* Testing, defect-management, and UAT coordination practices
* Demonstrated experience in data analysis, data validation, and issue investigation using SQL.
* Experience partnering with Business Analysts and Product Managers to create functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience with functional testing and UAT support or coordination, including defects, retesting, and sign-off readiness.
* Experience performing Scrum Master responsibilities for one or more Agile squads.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams in a matrix organization.
* Scrum Master certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent is preferred.

**Primary Skills**
Scrum Master, Functional analysis, data analysis, functional testing, UAT coordination, SQL
  
  
**Secondary Skills**
Data analyst
  
  
**Who We Are**
We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
**Required Skills**
Data Analysis, Functional Analysis, Functional Testing, Scrum, Structured Query Language (SQL), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), User Acceptance Testing Support
  
  
**Preferred Skills**
Data Analytics

title: Engineering Manager IT
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in IT project management, software development, or IT service delivery. Previous leadership experience required.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. PMP, ITIL, or Agile certifications preferred.
* Strong expertise in IT project management, Agile methodologies, and SDLC best practices with experience in IT infrastructure, software development, and enterprise IT solutions.
* Must have skills: Node.js, TypeScript, ECS, Kubernetes,Kore.AI, Android, iOS development
* Proficiency in risk management, budgeting, and IT governance. Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and IT compliance standards.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Business Systems Analysis Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities?
   

  

 Join our DTCC family, and you’ll grow your expertise and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll seek challenges with flexibility and patience, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life.
   

  

**Why You Love This Job**
 You will be part of the Enterprise Product \& Platform Engineering (EPPE) organization, responsible for providing centralized, independent infrastructure testing and quality assurance services. This role focuses on driving infrastructure testing delivery, governance, and coordination across projects, ensuring improved system stability, compliance, and release readiness.
   

  

 The Lead Business Systems Analyst will act as a delivery lead/project coordinator for infrastructure testing, managing backlog execution, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and reporting.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Infrastructure Testing Delivery \& Coordination
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end infrastructure testing delivery across multiple concurrent programs and releases
* Coordinate testing activities aligned with application and infrastructure release plans
* Act as the primary liaison between Infrastructure Engineering, Application Teams, and Test teams
* Ensure test readiness across environments (build validation, baseline validation, integration readiness)
* Track and manage dependencies, risks, and testing milestones


 Agile Delivery \& Work Management
   

  

* Drive JIRA\-based Agile delivery (Scrum/Kanban) including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization
* Manage and monitor story progress, defect tracking, and test execution status
* Ensure clear definition of acceptance criteria, test scope, and Definition of Done (DoD)
* Facilitate daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates
* Optimize workflow efficiency and reduce delivery bottlenecks


 Resource Planning \& Workload Management
   

  

* Plan and allocate resources based on priority, complexity, and delivery timelines
* Monitor utilization across onshore/offshore teams
* Balance competing priorities across multiple initiatives
* Identify capacity gaps and escalate proactively


 Metrics, Reporting \& Leadership Communication
   

  

* Prepare executive\-level dashboards, metrics, and status reports
* Provide insights on: \- Test coverage
* Automation progress
* Defects and quality trends
* Delivery risks and timelines
* Present program updates to Director\-level and senior stakeholders
* Drive data\-driven decision\-making using tools such as Power BI / dashboards


 Process, Governance \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to EPPE testing standards, governance, and audit requirements
* Identify process gaps and drive improvements through automation and standardization
* Implement controls for traceability, test coverage, and compliance validation
* Support audit readiness and documentation standards


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Product Management, Infrastructure Engineering, Application Development teams
* Communicate risks, blockers, and status clearly and proactively
* Influence outcomes without direct authority


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience)


 Talents Needed for Success
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in Business Systems Analysis, Infrastructure Testing, or Delivery/Program Coordination roles
* Familiarity with tools such as ServiceNow, Power BI, automation pipelines

title: Transformation Program Lead
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 Your role
   

  

 The Transformation Program Lead is a high\-impact, execution\-focused role at the heart of our operational transformation agenda. Sitting within the Transformation Office, this individual acts as the on\-the\-ground engine of change owing the end\-to\-end delivery of discrete process transformation initiatives, from diagnostic and design through to implementation and BAU handover.
   

  

 This is not a strategy\-only role. We are looking for someone who can think like a consultant and execute like an operator — structuring complex problems with rigor, driving workstreams to resolution, and embedding sustainable change that outlasts their tenure on any given initiative.
   

  

 In this role you will partner with our Global Process Owners, operational teams in our global Client Delivery Centers, Product and Technology, as well as leaders across Client Delivery and in our Lines of Business to define and execute our plans, in a regulated, client\-centric, and compliance\-minded environment.
   

  

**The Ideal Candidate**
 You are organised, analytical, and motivated by tangible outcomes. You are comfortable working through complexity and ambiguity, and you take ownership of your workstreams without needing to be micromanaged. You communicate clearly and confidently with a range of stakeholders, from operations analysts to mid\-senior leadership, and you take pride in delivering work to a high standard. You are eager to grow your program delivery and problem\-solving capabilities, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where your contribution is visible and valued.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

**Program Delivery \& Execution**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned transformation workstreams, managing tasks, timelines, milestones, risks, and dependencies
* Develop and maintain detailed workstream plans, ensuring activities are logically sequenced and progressing on track
* Contribute to a culture of accountability and pace, proactively flagging blockers and helping to resolve them
* Maintain thorough documentation of processes, decisions, and outcomes throughout the engagement lifecycle


**Problem\-Solving \& Issue Resolution**
* Apply structured problem\-solving techniques to analyze complex operational challenges — breaking down issues, gathering and interpreting data, and forming clear recommendations
* Proactively identify risks and issues within your workstreams and escalate with proposed mitigations
* Exercise sound judgement to manage competing priorities and maintain delivery momentum


**Stakeholder Management \& Communication**
* Build effective working relationships with business, operations, and technology counterparts across assigned initiatives
* Prepare clear and well\-structured workstream updates, status reports, and risk logs for review by senior program leads and leadership
* Support the facilitation of working group meetings, workshops, and stakeholder sessions, ensuring actions and decisions are captured and followed up


**Team Contribution \& Development**
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance and support to Business Analysts on the team, helping to structure their work and maintain quality standards
* Act as a collaborative and constructive team member, sharing knowledge and contributing to a positive team culture
* Continue to develop your own skills in program delivery, problem structuring, and stakeholder engagement


**Change Management \& BAU Handover**
* Assist in the design and documentation of target operating models, processes, controls, and performance metrics to sustain new ways of working
* Support BAU teams in preparing for handover, contributing to training materials, process documentation, and transition planning
* Participate in structured handover activities at program close, ensuring continuity and a clean transition to business\-as\-usual


**Essential**
 Skills \& Experience Required
   

  

* 5–8 years of professional experience, with a solid track record in program or project management, business analysis, process improvement, or management consulting
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver structured workstreams within complex, cross\-functional programs
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to interpret data, identify issues, and develop clear, actionable recommendations
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing written updates and facilitating working group sessions
* Well\-organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple workstreams concurrently
* A proactive, self\-starting approach with a strong sense of personal ownership and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, or AI\-assisted workflows)

* Prior exposure to a Transformation Office or similar centre of excellence
* Familiarity with change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci, Kotter) and/or project management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, PMP)
* Undergraduate degree from a leading institution; postgraduate qualification an advantage


 What we offer
   

  

* A high\-visibility, high\-impact role at the centre of the firm's transformation agenda
* Exposure to a breadth of strategic initiatives across the business
* A clear career pathway into senior transformation leadership, change, or operations roles
* The opportunity to build and shape a best\-in\-class Transformation Office capability
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


**Monthly base salary** 
 for this position is from 3,670 EUR to 5,400 EUR gross. Final offer will be determined based on your competencies, qualifications and professional experience
   

  

 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Product Management Intern
description:
**Description \& Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next\-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

**Product Management Intern – Growth \& Player Marketing**
**Location: Hyderabad (In office)**
**Duration: 8\- 10 weeks**
**About EA**
 Electronic Arts Inc. is a global leader in interactive entertainment. We develop and deliver games, content and online services across platforms. We have a broad portfolio of brands that span the most popular genres.
   

  

 We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees in an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allow our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.
   

  

 Join us in driving the next revolution in games.
   

  

**Help Us Create Games Players Love To Talk About**
 EA is looking for a Product Management Intern who is curious about players, data, culture, storytelling, and what makes a game stand out. The intern will report to a PM/ SPM and work closely with game designers, developers, artists, analysts, user researchers, and marketing teams to help us understand our audiences, shape how we communicate with players, and support campaigns that introduce more people to our games and encourage existing players to keep coming back.
   

  

 In this role, the intern will support the development and improvement of game features, live events, progression systems, monetization experiences, and player journeys. It will use a combination of player feedback, market research, game data, and structured problem\-solving to identify opportunities and help the team make better product decisions.
   

  

 This internship is ideal for someone who enjoys games, understands what makes players return to them, and wants to learn how successful games are designed, launched, measured, and improved.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product and Creative Collaboration
+ Collaborate with analysts, designers, engineers and artists to gather inputs, scope product requirements and communicate decisions to stakeholders.
+ Support product managers in defining features, events, progression systems, social features, and monetization experiences.
+ Participate in playtests, design reviews, sprint planning, and feature retrospectives.
+ Create product collaterals to document learnings, and support teams in tracking feature scope, development progress \& utilization.

* Campaigns and Game Launches
+ Help develop player communication journeys across push notifications, email, social media, community channels, and in\-game messages.
+ Support the planning and execution of campaigns for new features, events, content updates, and game launches.
+ Help create campaign briefs that define the audience, player insight, message, channels, and success metrics.
+ Contribute ideas for social media content, creator partnerships, in\-game messaging, app\-store promotions, and community activations.
+ Support A/B tests across messages, creative concepts, channels, offers, and audience segments.

* Market Research:
+ Conduct competitor research \& emerging trends to identify growth opportunities and propose product features to game leads.

* Player Insights:
+ Analyze game telemetry data to understand player behavior across areas such as onboarding, progression, retention, engagement, conversion, and monetization.
+ Identify drop\-offs, friction points, and underserved player needs within the game.
+ Understand player persona and expectations based on qualitative data from surveys, app\-store reviews, community channels, customer support, and social media.


**Must Have**
* Interest in games and understanding games as a business
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Structured problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-moving, cross\-functional environment.


**Good To Have**
* Familiarity with free\-to\-play games, live\-service games, and mobile games, and understanding of game metrics
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or another analytics tool.
* Experience creating surveys, analyzing customer feedback, or conducting user research.
* Experience participating in gaming communities, esports, game jams, fandoms, creator communities, or student clubs.


**What Success Will Look Like**
 During the internship, the intern should be able to:
   

  

* Develop a practical understanding of game development and product management lifecycle.
* Independently analyze a player or product problem and recommend potential solutions.
* Contribute to at least one feature, event, experiment, or product improvement from discovery through evaluation.
* Produce clear product documentation that helps cross\-functional teams make decisions.
* Build strong working relationships with product, design, engineering, art, analytics, and other partner teams.


**Sample Internship Projects**
 Depending On The Team’s Priorities, The Intern Will Be Assigned To a Game Team, And They May Work On Projects Such As
   

  

* Creating go\-to\-market strategy for a new game under development
* Analyzing the new player onboarding funnel and recommending improvements.
* Conducting a competitive review of progression or social systems.
* Identifying causes of player churn within a specific segment


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Manager, Software Development - 149
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Description**
 The Software Development Manager – Java \& SaaS (AI\-Assisted Development) will lead delivery execution for a small engineering team at Infor’s Hyderabad Development Center. The role requires 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including 4\+ years of hands\-on Java development, 2\+ years of technical leadership or engineering management experience, exposure to AWS\-based SaaS product development, and practical use of AI\-assisted software development tools to improve SDLC productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
   

  

**A Typical Day In The Life Includes**
* Introduce practical AI\-assisted development practices using approved tools and team workflows.
* Help the team use AI tools for requirements clarification, code understanding, first\-draft code generation, test case creation, documentation, defect analysis, and productivity improvement.
* Establish basic guardrails for responsible AI usage, including human review, validation of AI\-generated output, secure handling of enterprise data, and accountability for final deliverables.
* Lead a small team of developers, business analysts, and QA engineers through sprint planning, execution, quality checks, release readiness, and production support.
* Provide technical guidance for Java\-based SaaS business application development, including design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, refactoring, and defect resolution.
* Remain hands\-on in the codebase: contribute code, pair on hard problems, and build rapid prototypes and technical spikes with AI\-assisted tooling to test feasibility and settle design questions before the team commits to an approach.
* Support development of scalable, secure, multi\-tenant SaaS applications on AWS, with attention to tenant isolation, configurability, performance, reliability, observability, and operational readiness.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical tasks in partnership with BAs, product owners, QA, and engineering stakeholders.
* Ensure the team follows SDLC and Agile practices, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, release management, and post\-release support.

title: Project Management Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an organised, detail\-oriented and proactive individual to manage small projects end to end and to support Project Managers and Project Analysts in the day\-to\-day coordination, tracking and governance of larger Change, Transformation and Transition (Lift\-Out) projects across Global Client Delivery (GCD) locations. The ideal candidate will independently run small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives using the team's SWAT and Transition frameworks, while acting as the operational backbone of the Projects team – keeping plans, trackers, action logs and evidence current; scheduling and minuting governance forums; chasing actions to closure; and ensuring the team's tools and templates are consistently used. This is an individual contributor role in the Projects team with no direct reports, reporting to the Head of Projects, and is the foundation for a career in project and programme management at Alter Domus.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Small Project Management**
* Independently manage small, well\-scoped projects and ad hoc initiatives (e.g. single\-team process changes, small work transfers or Transition Lite items, tooling or reporting roll\-outs, remediation actions) from kick\-off to closure, applying the SWAT and Toll Gate frameworks proportionately
* Define scope, success criteria, timeline and stakeholders for small projects with the Business / CD Lead, publish a simple plan and run regular check\-points to drive the actions to completion
* Identify and log risks, issues and dependencies for own projects, resolve them at working level and escalate to the Head of Projects or a Project Manager where a decision or intervention is required
* Provide status updates on own projects into the team's weekly reporting and governance forums and complete closure and lessons\-learnt documentation


**Project Coordination \& Tracking**
* Maintain project plans, trackers and checklists for assigned projects – including the Transition Checklist, recruitment / onboarding tracker, access and IT tracker, training completion records and impacted\-teams register – ensuring they are accurate and up to date at all times
* Track actions, owners and due dates from all project meetings and proactively follow up with owners across Business, Tech, Client Delivery and cross\-functional teams to drive closure
* Support the Project Manager / Project Analyst in preparing detailed plans, timelines and milestone schedules and in updating them as the project evolves
* Own defined workstreams within larger Transition and Transformation projects under the guidance of a Project Manager


**Governance Forums \& Toll Gate Support**
* Organise and support governance forums – schedule Tier 2 (weekly) and Tier 3 (operational) meetings, bi\-weekly transition reviews and toll\-gate (TG1/TG2/TG3\) reviews; prepare agendas, circulate pre\-reads, capture minutes, decisions and actions and distribute them promptly
* Collect, file and index toll\-gate evidence (sign\-off emails, approved plans, acceptance forms, training and access confirmations) in the designated SharePoint / Confluence locations and keep the evidence checklist current
* Chase pending sign\-offs from LoB, CD Leads, GPOs, Academy, IT and Control Tower ahead of toll\-gate dates and flag anything at risk to the Project Manager
* Maintain the decision log and action log for assigned projects


**Risk, Issue \& Dependency Logging**
* Capture risks, issues and dependencies raised in meetings and by stakeholders into the RAID log with clear descriptions, owners and target dates
* Monitor open items for ageing and overdue status and highlight them to the Project Manager / Project Analyst for escalation
* Support the preparation of escalation notes and mitigation trackers


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Prepare first drafts of status reports – weekly project updates, the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update and governance packs – by collecting inputs from Project Managers, Tech PMO and stakeholders and populating the standard templates
* Update KPI trackers and dashboards (hiring progress, onboarding, training completion, KC/KT scorecards, milestone status) with validated data from source teams
* Maintain project documentation – charters, stakeholder lists, RACI, communication plans, SOP / process documentation packs received from LoBs – with correct version control
* Ensure all project artefacts are stored in the agreed structure on SharePoint / Confluence and are easy for stakeholders to find


**Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication**
* Act as the day\-to\-day point of contact for routine queries, data requests and scheduling across global delivery locations and time zones
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams – Talent Acquisition, Academy (KC/KT), IT / Access, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Facilities and Control Tower – to obtain inputs and confirm completion of their actions
* Draft clear and professional meeting invites, minutes, follow\-up notes and status communications for review by the Project Manager
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders and represent the Projects team professionally


**Tools, Templates \& PMO Administration**
* Administer Jira boards, Confluence spaces and SharePoint libraries for assigned projects – creating and updating items, maintaining workflows and access lists and ensuring data hygiene
* Apply the team's standard templates (Transition Acceptance Document, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates, status report and RAID templates) and suggest practical improvements based on usage
* Support onboarding of new project stakeholders to the team's tools and ways of working
* Support post\-project reviews by collating feedback, lessons learnt and closure documentation


**PROFILE**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations or related field
* Project management foundation certification (CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile / Scrum fundamentals) or willingness to obtain within the first year
* Overall 3\-7 years' experience in back office, BPO or Financial Services domain
* 2\-5 years of project coordination and execution experience – supporting or running projects, workstreams or process changes in a project, PMO or operations role
* Exposure to transitions, process migrations, change initiatives or working with global / multi\-location teams an advantage


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in Excel (pivots, lookups, basic charts), PowerPoint and Outlook; exposure to Power BI an advantage
* Working knowledge of collaboration and project tools – SharePoint, MS Teams, Jira, Confluence or equivalent
* Familiarity with basic project management concepts – plans, milestones, RAID logs, action tracking, minutes


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Specialist, Business Agility
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Scrum Master with experience leading cross\-functional teams to support business functions. In this role, you’ll facilitate agile delivery across a broad range of initiatives including data platform enhancements, dashboard development, automation, and data product delivery. The ideal candidate combines agile expertise with strong communication skills and a foundational understanding of data life cycles, analytics tooling, and enterprise project delivery.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Serve as Scrum Master for 1–3 Agile teams focused on delivering data and analytics solutions.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews.
* Collaborate with Product Owners to groom and maintain a well\-defined backlog aligned to business priorities.
* Remove blockers and support teams in achieving sprint goals and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate across stakeholders in IT and different business teams.
* Track team metrics (velocity, burn\-down, etc.) and report progress to leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, agility, and transparency.
* Ensure alignment to Agile best practices, scaling frameworks (e.g., SAFe), and delivery standards.
* Support onboarding of new team members and promote team engagement.


**What Should You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or any related field.
* 3\-7 years of experience as a Scrum Master in a technology or data environment.


**Primary Skills (must\-have)**
* Hands\-on experience with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally)
* Strong facilitation, communication, and servant leadership skills
* Exposure to data projects (e.g., data pipelines, BI dashboards, data governance, reporting)
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams across IT and business units
* Scrum Master Certification (CSM, PSM, or equivalent)


**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**
* Relevant certifications
* Experience in large enterprise settings or highly regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance)
* Understanding of back\-office operations (e.g., finance reporting cycles, HR metrics)
* Familiarity with data tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, or Databricks
* Experience with Agile\-at\-scale frameworks (e.g., SAFe, LeSS)


**Who We Are**
 We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Agile Application Development, Animal Vaccination, Biopharmaceutical Industry, Business Administration, Capability Development, Change Management, Classroom Delivery, Client Counseling, Communication, Data Governance, Digital Transformation, Human Resource Metrics, Learning Design, Methodical Approach, Organizational Agility, Organizational Structures, Project Delivery, Servant Leadership, Sprint Planning, Teaching
